items.title: 中國交出2026 APEC東道主成績單！75項成果與互聯互通藍圖勾勒亞太共同體路線圖
items.title_en: China Delivers 2026 APEC Host Report Card: 75 Achievements and an Interconnectivity Blueprint Outline the Asia‑Pacific Community Roadmap
paras: 今年中國擔任亞太經合會(APEC)東道主，周四(19日)正式對外發布成果清單，共計75項，涵蓋會議成果文件、重大倡議與務實合作三大層級；其中備受矚目的《APEC互聯互通藍圖》同步出爐，以「硬聯通、軟聯通、心聯通」三支柱為框架，把亞太共同體建設從願景推向可執行的年度清單。
根據中國外交部網站公布的內容，75項成果分為三塊：18項會議成果文件、3項中方推進亞太共同體建設重大舉措、54項務實合作成果。

APEC領袖層級通過《APEC領導人關於建設亞太共同體的深圳展望》、《APEC貿易數字化合作框架（2027—2030）》、《APEC互聯互通藍圖》及《關於亞太地區新興技術促進就業和繁榮的聲明》四份核心文件；部長級會議則涵蓋外交貿易、數字與AI、能源、糧食安全、中小企業、財政、運輸、人力資源等13份聯合聲明或主席聲明，其中包括在成都發布的數位和AI部長會議聲明、在蘇州發布的貿易部長會議聯合聲明、在南京發布的人力資源開發部長聲明。
中國同時端出三項旗艦舉措：成立亞太共同體研究中心(深圳)、倡議成立世界灣區經濟合作聯盟、提供2000萬美元資助開展APEC務實合作，被視為把智庫、平台與資金三者綁定的長期布局。
54項務實合作則按經貿、聯通、創新、發展四大方面展開。經貿方面，會上發布《關於亞太自貿區的聲明》、啟動APEC無紙貿易卓越中心、推出數位貿易政策對話與AI創新倡議。
聯通方面則有宣布延長APEC商務旅行卡停留期、擴員亞太示範電子口岸網絡、發布《APEC互聯互通藍圖（2015-2025）》終期審議報告。
創新方面則有設立「AI+能源」專項任務組、中國-APEC數位技術賦能中心、數據跨境流動合作中國中心。
發展方面則涵蓋健康老化行動計劃、零碳城市合作框架、清潔能源培訓學院、中小企業合作區與青年財經人才交流等。

作為本輪成果的骨架，《互聯互通藍圖》給出三條施力路徑。「硬聯通」聚焦陸海空與多式聯運、能源基建互聯、下一代通訊與低軌衛星、農村數位覆蓋，並強調把韌性減災與全週期成本納入項目規劃；「軟聯通」則指向海關現代化、邊境後壁壘拆除、供應鏈堵點破解、跨境隱私規則對接與資本市場互聯；「心聯通」則落在商務旅行卡與虛擬商旅卡、終身學習與技能再培訓、中小微企業正規化、文化旅遊便利化。藍圖明確2027至2030年將於每年一次高官會跟蹤落實情況。
從產業視角看，這份清單最值得關注的不是項目數量，而是AI、能源、數據、中小企業四條線被同時寫進規則層。AI與能源雙向賦能政策推薦、數位智能標準賦能綠色低碳倡議、分布式數據驗證平台倡議等，意味著中方試圖把新興技術議題從「展示」推進到「標準與平台」階段；而商旅卡延期、無紙貿易中心、電子口岸擴員，則是把交通便利化直接轉化為企業可感知的成本下降。
不過，75項成果的含金量最終取決於落實速度。多數文件屬非約束性倡議，2027年起的高官會年度審議將是第一個真實對帳點，亞太共同體則是停在公報裡，還是走進企業的報關單、簽證頁與電網調度室，未來兩年將見分曉。
paras_en: This year China served as host of the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) and on Thursday (the 19th) officially released a list of achievements, totaling 75 items covering three tiers: meeting outcome documents, major initiatives, and practical cooperation. Among them, the highly‑anticipated "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint" was unveiled, structured around three pillars—hard connectivity, soft connectivity, and heart‑to‑heart connectivity—shifting the Asia‑Pacific community building from vision to an actionable annual agenda.

According to content posted on the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs website, the 75 outcomes are divided into three sections: 18 meeting outcome documents, three major initiatives by China to advance the Asia‑Pacific community, and 54 practical cooperation results.

At the leaders’ level, APEC adopted four core documents: the "APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook on Building an Asia‑Pacific Community," the "APEC Trade Digitalization Cooperation Framework (2027‑2030)," the "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint," and the "Statement on Emerging Technologies Promoting Employment and Prosperity in the Asia‑Pacific Region." Ministerial meetings produced 13 joint or chair statements covering foreign trade, digital and AI, energy, food security, SMEs, finance, transport, and human resources, including the digital and AI ministers’ statement released in Chengdu, the trade ministers’ joint statement released in Suzhou, and the human‑resource development ministers’ statement released in Nanjing.

China also put forward three flagship initiatives: establishing an Asia‑Pacific Community Research Center in Shenzhen, proposing the creation of a World Bay Area Economic Cooperation Alliance, and providing US$20 million to fund APEC practical cooperation, a long‑term strategy linking think‑tank expertise, platform building, and financing.

The 54 practical cooperation items are organized into four themes: trade and economics, connectivity, innovation, and development. In the trade and economics area, the summit issued a "Statement on the Asia‑Pacific Free Trade Area," launched an APEC Paper‑less Trade Excellence Center, and introduced a digital trade policy dialogue and AI innovation initiative.

In the connectivity domain, the summit announced an extension of the APEC Business Travel Card validity, expanded the Asia‑Pacific Demonstration Electronic Port Network, and released the final review report of the "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint (2015‑2025)."
On innovation, the summit established a dedicated "AI + Energy" task force, a China‑APEC Digital Technology Enablement Center, and a China Center for Cross‑Border Data Flow Cooperation.

The development pillar includes a Healthy Aging Action Plan, a Zero‑Carbon City Cooperation Framework, a Clean Energy Training Institute, SME cooperation zones, and youth finance talent exchange programs.

The "Interconnectivity Blueprint"—the backbone of this round of outcomes—outlines three implementation pathways. "Hard connectivity" focuses on land, sea, air and multimodal transport, energy‑infrastructure links, next‑generation communications and low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, and rural digital coverage, emphasizing resilience, disaster mitigation, and life‑cycle cost in project planning. "Soft connectivity" targets customs modernization, removal of border frictions, resolution of supply‑chain bottlenecks, alignment of cross‑border privacy rules, and capital‑market integration. "Heart‑to‑heart connectivity" covers business travel cards and virtual travel cards, lifelong learning and skills retraining, formalization of micro‑, small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises, and facilitation of cultural tourism. The blueprint specifies that from 2027 to 2030, senior‑official meetings will annually track implementation.

From an industry perspective, the most noteworthy aspect of the list is not the sheer number of projects but the inclusion of AI, energy, data, and SMEs across the regulatory layer. Policies that mutually empower AI and energy, digital‑intelligent standards that enable green low‑carbon initiatives, and proposals for distributed data verification platforms indicate China’s intent to move emerging‑technology topics from showcase to standards and platform stages. Meanwhile, extensions of business travel cards, the paper‑less trade center, and expansion of electronic ports translate improved mobility directly into tangible cost reductions for enterprises.

However, the ultimate value of the 75 outcomes depends on implementation speed. Most documents are non‑binding initiatives, and the annual senior‑official review starting in 2027 will be the first real accountability checkpoint. Whether the Asia‑Pacific community remains a statement in a communiqué or becomes embedded in customs declarations, visa pages, and power‑grid dispatch rooms will become clear over the next two years.

items.title: 台股跌跌不休 林修銘信心喊話：基本面穩健、AI中長期仍看俏
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Keep Falling, Lin Hsiu-Ming Says Confidence: Fundamentals Solid, AI Still Promising Long‑Term
paras: 台股跌跌不休，今(20)日終場大跌2,393.6點或6.23%，收在36,033.29點，不僅創下近7個月新低，更寫下台股史上第3大收盤跌點。面對市場波動加劇，臺灣證券交易所董事長林修銘對市場信心喊話，強調短期市場波動不改台灣產業基本面與長期競爭優勢，呼籲投資人回歸基本面理性看待，證交所也將持續強化市場韌性與交易安全。
林修銘指出，台灣資本市場與國際市場連結緊密，短期難免受到國際政經情勢及市場情緒影響，但台灣企業歷經美中貿易紛爭、新冠疫情及全球供應鏈重組等挑戰，持續透過技術創新與全球布局，展現高度應變能力與產業韌性。
針對市場關注的AI產業前景，林修銘表示，從國際科技大廠財報及投資規劃觀察，全球AI運算及基礎建設需求仍具中長期成長空間。他強調，台灣從半導體製造、先進封裝到AI伺服器及系統整合均具深厚實力，形成多年累積的完整產業生態系，國際AI大廠持續擴大與台廠合作，凸顯台灣在全球科技供應鏈的關鍵地位。
在總體經濟與上市櫃營運表現上，證交所列出多項數據指出基本面仍具成長動能：台灣今年前三季經濟成長率達14.22%，上市公司前10月營收年增近四成，前三季稅前淨利更年增超過八成。林修銘呼籲投資人面對短期波動時，更應回歸企業基本面，對台灣產業的長期競爭力保持信心。
在市場風險與交易秩序方面，林修銘強調，維護市場交易秩序與安全是證交所最重要的責任。據證交所觀察，集中市場融資餘額較上月高點減少逾1,500億元，顯示市場槓桿部位持續調整；違約交割及融資追繳處分情形目前尚未出現明顯異常。證交所將持續強化市場監視與風險管理機制，密切掌握交易動態與風險指標，並與主管機關合作，如發現異常將依權責即時處理。
金管會昨(19)日已宣布自 20 日起實施新一波市場穩定措施，適度限制跌幅較大個股次一交易日的融券及借券賣出價格，並調降借券賣出委託數量上限，以減緩短期集中賣壓。林修銘說明，相關措施並非全面禁止放空，投資人仍可依規定進行融券、借券賣出及運用衍生性商品避險，兼顧正常交易需求與市場穩定，證交所也將持續觀察情勢並配合主管機關適時檢討調整。
此外，林修銘表示，市場信心需要充分的資訊揭露與良好的企業溝通。證交所將持續督促上市公司落實重大資訊揭露，鼓勵企業主動說明營運成果、經營策略與未來展望，並鼓勵公司在衡酌財務狀況與股東權益後，適時評估實施庫藏股，展現對長期經營的信心。同時，證交所也會加強關注市場不實消息，若媒體報導或市場觀念有所偏誤，將適時對外提供正確完整說明，並與主管機關及各界攜手推動資本市場長期穩健發展。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market continued its decline, ending the day (20th) down 2,393.6 points or 6.23% at 36,033.29 points, not only hitting a seven‑month low but also recording the third‑largest closing point drop in Taiwan market history. Facing heightened market volatility, Taiwan Stock Exchange Chairman Lin Hsiu‑Ming voiced confidence in the market, stressing that short‑term swings do not change the solid fundamentals and long‑term competitive advantages of Taiwan’s industries, urging investors to return to fundamentals and view the market rationally, while the exchange will keep strengthening market resilience and trading safety.

Lin noted that Taiwan’s capital market is closely linked to international markets, so short‑term fluctuations are inevitably influenced by global political‑economic conditions and market sentiment. Nevertheless, Taiwanese companies have weathered challenges such as the US‑China trade dispute, the COVID‑19 pandemic, and global supply‑chain restructuring, continuously leveraging technological innovation and global expansion to demonstrate strong adaptability and industry resilience.

Addressing concerns about the AI sector’s outlook, Lin said that, based on the financial reports and investment plans of major international tech firms, global demand for AI computing and infrastructure still has medium‑ to long‑term growth potential. He emphasized that Taiwan possesses deep capabilities across semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, AI servers and system integration, forming a mature, multi‑year‑built ecosystem. International AI giants are expanding cooperation with Taiwanese firms, highlighting Taiwan’s pivotal role in the global tech supply chain.

Regarding overall economic and listed‑company performance, the exchange cited several data points showing continued growth momentum: Taiwan’s GDP grew 14.22% in the first three quarters of this year, the top‑10 listed companies saw revenue increase by nearly 40% year‑on‑year through October, and pre‑tax profit for the first three quarters rose by over 80% year‑on‑year. Lin urged investors, amid short‑term volatility, to focus on corporate fundamentals and maintain confidence in the long‑term competitiveness of Taiwan’s industries.

On market risk and trading order, Lin stressed that safeguarding trading order and safety is the exchange’s top responsibility. Observations show that margin financing balances in the centralized market fell by more than NT$150 billion from last month’s peak, indicating ongoing adjustment of leveraged positions; no obvious anomalies have appeared in default deliveries or margin calls. The exchange will continue to enhance market surveillance and risk‑management mechanisms, closely monitor trading dynamics and risk indicators, and cooperate with regulators to address any irregularities promptly.

The Financial Supervisory Commission announced on the 19th that new market‑stabilizing measures would take effect on the 20th, modestly limiting short‑selling and borrowing‑sell prices for stocks that fell sharply the previous day and lowering the ceiling on borrowing‑sell order quantities to ease concentrated selling pressure. Lin clarified that these measures do not constitute a blanket short‑selling ban; investors may still engage in margin borrowing, short‑selling and use derivatives for hedging, balancing normal trading needs with market stability. The exchange will keep monitoring the situation and work with regulators to adjust measures as needed.

Finally, Lin said market confidence requires ample information disclosure and good corporate communication. The exchange will keep urging listed companies to fulfill major information‑disclosure obligations, encourage firms to proactively explain operating results, strategies and outlook, and, after weighing financial conditions and shareholder interests, consider timely share‑buybacks to demonstrate confidence in long‑term operations. The exchange will also strengthen monitoring of false market rumors and, if media reports or market perceptions are misleading, provide accurate explanations and collaborate with regulators and stakeholders to promote the long‑term healthy development of the capital market.

items.title: 〈數位至匯登興櫃〉從半導體、創投轉戰移工匯兌 引進台達電等長線資金打造服務生態圈
items.title_en: Digital-to-Remittance to List on the Emerging Stock Board, Shifting from Semiconductors and Venture Capital to Migrant Worker Remittances, Attracting Long‑Term Capital like Delta Electronics to Build a Service Ecosystem
paras: 從半導體、電子材料到私募創投，數位至匯(7973-TW)董事長暨執行長魏仁裕在2022年初正式掌舵後，選擇一條看似冷門卻緊扣台灣產業缺工趨勢的賽道—移工跨境金融。他指出，這段跨界創業並非來自精算後的商業評估，而是早年家中聘請外籍看護照顧生病父親時，陪著移工匯款、逛印尼店的日常體悟。
數位至匯即將登錄興櫃，董事長暨執行長魏仁裕談起跨足移工跨境金融的起點，「做生意不能只看短線獲利，更要站在服務移工的出發點，幫他們在台安穩生活、照顧家人。」這個創業的起心動念源自早年照顧生病父親、陪伴外籍看護匯款與逛印尼店的日常經驗，他進而看見移工在台工作、匯款與生活的真實需求。
魏仁裕過去在科技與材料領域的經歷，主要集中於面板光學材料與電子量測儀器／半導體設備，同時也橫跨創投與私募股權投資。他 2021 年底買下公司、2022 年初正式掌舵。在股權結構上，他引進台達電、佳世達等產業資金及零售通路、金融業股東，就是看重長期資金的穩定性，而非創投的短期出場壓力；公司內部亦維持扁平化組織架構，讓團隊在取得執照與開辦多國業務上得以快速反應。
談及市場競爭與移工處境，魏仁裕指出，目前合法持牌業者前幾大合計市占率已具相當規模，各家策略各有不同，而市場上推估仍有約20%至30%的黑市或地下匯兌空間，加上越南今年初加強管控地下匯兌，使當地合規匯款成長加速。
至於泰國與印度等市場，公司則視法規開放進度與資源配置審慎推進。在客戶結構上，印尼以家事移工為主、越南多為廠工、菲律賓各半，隨著各國匯款均穩健成長，菲律賓與越南近期成長力道尤為顯著。
針對移工來台前常須向當地仲介或高利借貸、背負沉重債務的現象，魏仁裕透露，公司憑藉在台會員基礎與印尼當地執照及銀行合作網絡，正推動跨境延伸服務與先買後付(BNPL)機制，協助減輕移工還款與消費負擔，同時希望透過合法、透明的金融管道，降低移工遭剝削的風險。
魏仁裕也特別把焦點轉向移工在台面臨的另一項難題，部分移工在台生下孩子卻缺乏身分。他提到，像是文山區「關愛之家」等機構收容了不少無國籍或身分不明的幼童，因法令限制，這些孩子無法長期留在台灣，也面臨返國銜接的挑戰，期盼社會與政府相關單位能給予更多關注與協助，讓孩子們能在適齡階段回到母國獲得妥善照顧。
paras_en: After moving from semiconductors, electronic materials and private‑equity venture capital, Digital-to-Remittance (7973‑TW) chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu took the helm in early 2022 and chose a seemingly niche but tightly linked track to Taiwan’s labor shortage trend—cross‑border finance for migrant workers. He said the venture was not born from actuarial business analysis but from personal experience helping a foreign caregiver remit money and shop at Indonesian stores while caring for his sick father.

Digital-to-Remittance is about to list on the Emerging Stock Board. Chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu explained the starting point of entering migrant‑worker cross‑border finance: “Doing business cannot focus only on short‑term profit; it must start from serving migrant workers, helping them live stably in Taiwan and support their families.” This entrepreneurial motive stemmed from his early experience caring for his ill father and accompanying a foreign caregiver in remitting funds and shopping in Indonesia, where he recognized the real needs of migrant workers in Taiwan for work, remittance and daily life.

Wei’s background in technology and materials was mainly in panel optical materials, electronic measurement instruments and semiconductor equipment, while also spanning venture capital and private‑equity investing. He bought the company at the end of 2021 and officially took charge in early 2022. In the equity structure he brought in industry capital and shareholders from Delta Electronics, Qisda and retail and financial sectors, valuing the stability of long‑term funding over the short‑term exit pressure of venture capital; the company also maintains a flat organizational structure, enabling the team to react quickly in obtaining licenses and launching multi‑country operations.

Regarding market competition and migrant‑worker conditions, Wei noted that the top licensed operators already command a sizable combined market share, each pursuing different strategies. Nonetheless, the market is estimated to still have about 20%‑30% of black‑market or underground remittance space, and Vietnam’s tightened crackdown on underground remittances earlier this year has accelerated growth in compliant transfers there.

For markets such as Thailand and India, the company proceeds cautiously based on regulatory openness and resource allocation. In terms of customer composition, Indonesia is dominated by domestic‑helper migrants, Vietnam mainly by factory workers, and the Philippines is split roughly half‑and‑half. As remittances from all countries grow steadily, recent growth momentum is especially strong in the Philippines and Vietnam.

Addressing the common issue of migrants incurring high‑interest loans or heavy debt through local agents before coming to Taiwan, Wei revealed that the company, leveraging its member base in Taiwan and its Indonesian license and banking network, is rolling out cross‑border extended services and a buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) mechanism to ease repayment and consumption burdens. The aim is also to reduce exploitation risk by providing legal, transparent financial channels.

Wei also highlighted another challenge faced by migrant workers in Taiwan: some have children born locally but lack legal status. He mentioned that facilities such as the “Caring Home” in Wenshan District shelter many stateless or undocumented children. Because of legal restrictions, these children cannot stay long‑term in Taiwan and face difficulties returning to their home countries. He hopes society and relevant government agencies will give more attention and assistance so the children can receive proper care when they return to their mothers’ countries at an appropriate age.

items.title: 群聯推太空專用SSD搶攻軌道資料中心市場 攜手Lonestar明年上半年發射升空
items.title_en: Phison Launches Space‑Specific SSD to Target Orbital Data Center Market, Partners with Lonestar for Launch in Early 2027
paras: NAND控制晶片廠群聯(8299-TW)今(20)日宣布推出全新Pascari Space太空專用SSD解決方案，正式拓展商業太空應用及太空軌道基礎設施儲存市場。其中，群聯將攜手美國太空資料中心業者Lonestar Data Holdings，支援其首個商業軌道資料中心節點StarVault-001，預計2027年上半年發射升空，屆時將搭載488TB群聯Pascari Space SSD，提供約370TB可用儲存容量。
群聯指出，隨著太空發射成本持續下降，太空軌道基礎設施及衛星應用逐步發展，加上地面資料中心面臨電力消耗、散熱、空間及天然災害等挑戰，市場對高可靠度、高效能太空儲存技術的需求也持續增加，應用涵蓋環境監測、森林砍伐防治、太空探索及科學研究等領域。
群聯表示，Pascari Space建立於超過26年的NAND儲存技術研發經驗，並結合旗下IMAGIN+客製化NAND儲存解決方案與ASIC設計服務，可依不同太空任務需求，針對元件選擇、韌體、耐用度、資料保存能力及抗輻射能力等進行客製化設計。

群聯過去已將儲存技術導入NASA火星探測車，並於2025年與Lonestar合作，將資料中心硬體部署於月球，相關技術已達技術成熟度第9級(TRL-9)。此次推出的Pascari Space進一步依任務需求區分為三大產品線，包括著重可靠度及系統韌性的Flight Critical飛行關鍵型儲存、兼顧效能與耐用度的Main Storage主儲存，以及滿足大量資料需求的Orbital Data Center太空軌道資料中心儲存。
在技術方面，Pascari Space透過群聯自主研發的控制晶片及韌體，提供最高可達60倍的耐用度提升，並導入資料清理(Data Scrubbing)及隨機化RAID映射設計。此外，也整合LDPC錯誤更正碼、SmartECC、SmartRefresh及SRAM交錯技術，提升資料完整性與系統可靠度。
針對太空環境中的輻射風險，群聯也提供總游離輻射劑量(TID)及單粒子效應(SEE)等輻射特性分析服務，涵蓋重離子測試及產品製造後的批次測試，協助客戶依不同任務需求強化儲存設備的環境耐受能力。
群聯執行長潘健成表示，太空正迅速成為下一個重要的資料基礎設施發展領域，但太空SSD在飛行任務中面臨的挑戰，遠高於地面系統。透過Pascari Space系列，群聯將儲存技術延伸至太空領域，讓客戶可依不同任務需求客製化儲存方案，從飛行安全相關的關鍵儲存系統，到太空軌道資料中心，協助建構下一世代太空基礎設施。
此次合作的Lonestar Data Holdings創辦人Chris Stott指出，資料是支撐全球經濟、企業營運及AI工作流程的重要基礎，透過StarVault，將在地球之外建構安全且具自主掌控能力的資料基礎設施，降低地面環境風險，並為未來太空中的AI與運算服務奠定基礎，而群聯儲存技術是StarVault架構中的重要一環。
paras_en: Phison (8299‑TW) announced today that it is introducing a brand‑new Pascari Space SSD solution designed for space, formally expanding into the commercial space‑application and orbital‑infrastructure storage markets. Phison will partner with U.S. space‑data‑center operator Lonestar Data Holdings to support its first commercial orbital data‑center node, StarVault‑001, slated for launch in the first half of 2027 and equipped with 488 TB of Phison Pascari Space SSDs, delivering roughly 370 TB of usable capacity.

Phison noted that as launch costs continue to fall, orbital infrastructure and satellite applications are maturing, while terrestrial data centers face challenges such as power consumption, heat dissipation, space constraints and natural‑disaster risk. Consequently, demand for highly reliable, high‑performance space storage technology is growing, with applications ranging from environmental monitoring and forest‑preservation to space exploration and scientific research.

Phison said the Pascari Space line builds on more than 26 years of NAND storage R&D and combines its IMAGIN+ custom NAND storage solutions with ASIC design services, allowing component selection, firmware, durability, data‑retention and radiation‑hardening to be tailored to the specific needs of each space mission.

Phison has previously supplied storage technology to NASA’s Mars rovers and, in 2025, partnered with Lonestar to deploy data‑center hardware on the Moon, achieving Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL‑9). The new Pascari Space portfolio is divided into three product lines based on mission requirements: the Flight‑Critical line for maximum reliability and system resilience, the Main Storage line balancing performance and durability, and the Orbital Data Center line for high‑volume data storage needs.

Technically, Pascari Space leverages Phison’s in‑house controller chips and firmware to deliver up to 60× endurance improvement, incorporates data‑scrubbing and randomized RAID mapping, and integrates LDPC error‑correction, SmartECC, SmartRefresh and SRAM interleaving to boost data integrity and system reliability.

To address radiation hazards in space, Phison also offers total ionizing dose (TID) and single‑event effect (SEE) analysis services, including heavy‑ion testing and post‑manufacturing batch testing, helping customers enhance the environmental tolerance of their storage devices for specific missions.

Phison CEO Pan Chien‑cheng said space is rapidly becoming the next critical data‑infrastructure frontier, but space SSDs face far greater challenges than ground‑based systems. With the Pascari Space series, Phison extends its storage expertise to space, enabling customers to customize solutions from flight‑critical storage to orbital data centers and help build the next‑generation space infrastructure.

Lonestar Data Holdings founder Chris Stott said data underpins the global economy, enterprise operations and AI workflows. Through StarVault, Lonestar aims to build secure, sovereign data infrastructure beyond Earth, reducing ground‑environment risks and laying the groundwork for future AI and compute services in space, with Phison’s storage technology playing a key role in the StarVault architecture.

items.title: 碳交所攜手證交所響應「氣候倡議敲鐘」聚焦能源管理與循環經濟、加速企業低碳轉型
items.title_en: Carbon Exchange Partners with Stock Exchange to Respond to “Ring the Bell for Climate,” Focusing on Energy Management and Circular Economy, Accelerating Corporate Low‑Carbon Transformation
paras: 為協助企業落實低碳轉型，證交所於本(11)月4日攜手碳交所及碳權研究與管理服務中心，共同舉辦「企業實質減碳策略與實務 Ⅰ & Ⅱ」講座。課程聚焦能源管理與循環經濟兩大主題，透過專業知識與實務經驗分享，協助企業掌握提升能源使用效率及促進資源循環利用的策略，將減碳目標融入日常管理與營運決策，逐步建立符合自身需求的減碳路徑。
證交所為持續發揮資本市場推動永續轉型的角色，今(2026)年再度響應世界交易所聯合會(WFE)發起的「氣候倡議敲鐘」(Ring the Bell for Climate)活動，今年適逢第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會(COP31)召開，證交所透過推廣企業減碳實務，以具體行動展現臺灣資本市場對全球氣候倡議的支持。
為營造健全的永續發展生態系，是證交所推動資本市場發展的重要方向。證交所持續從強化公司治理、提升永續資訊揭露品質及支持企業轉型等面向推進，並結合碳交所與相關專業機構的資源，協助企業在永續資訊揭露與能力建構的基礎上，進一步落實減碳策略，將永續管理融入經營布局，厚植臺灣資本市場的長期競爭力。
今年第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會(COP31)於11月9日至20日在土耳其召開，重點聚焦加速落實全球氣候行動，將氣候承諾轉化為具體且可衡量的成果。呼應此一方向，證交所響應WFE氣候倡議，從企業實質減碳需求出發，推動能源管理與循環經濟的實務交流。未來將持續關注氣候變遷議題，深化跨機構合作，支持企業將減碳策略落實於日常營運，為臺灣邁向2050淨零排放目標邁進。
paras_en: To help companies implement low‑carbon transformation, the Stock Exchange on November 4 held a joint seminar titled “Corporate Substantive Carbon‑Reduction Strategies and Practices I & II” together with the Carbon Exchange and the Carbon Rights Research and Management Service Center. The courses focused on two themes—energy management and the circular economy—and, through professional knowledge and practical experience sharing, assisted firms in mastering strategies to improve energy‑use efficiency and promote resource‑circulation utilization, integrating carbon‑reduction goals into daily management and operational decisions, and gradually establishing carbon‑reduction pathways that meet their own needs.

The Stock Exchange, continuing to play its role in driving sustainable transformation via the capital market, again responded this year (2026) to the World Federation of Exchanges’ (WFE) “Ring the Bell for Climate” initiative. Coinciding with the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31), the exchange showcases Taiwan’s capital market support for global climate initiatives by promoting corporate carbon‑reduction practices through concrete actions.

Creating a sound ecosystem for sustainable development is a key direction for the Stock Exchange’s market development. It continuously advances corporate governance, enhances the quality of sustainability disclosures, and supports corporate transformation. By leveraging resources from the Carbon Exchange and related professional bodies, the exchange helps companies not only improve sustainability reporting and capability building but also implement carbon‑reduction strategies, embedding sustainability management into business planning and strengthening the long‑term competitiveness of Taiwan’s capital market.

The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) was held in Turkey from November 9 to 20, focusing on accelerating global climate action and turning climate commitments into concrete, measurable results. Aligning with this direction, the Stock Exchange responded to the WFE climate initiative by promoting practical exchanges on energy management and the circular economy based on firms’ substantive carbon‑reduction needs. Going forward, it will continue to monitor climate‑change issues, deepen cross‑institutional cooperation, and support companies in embedding carbon‑reduction strategies into daily operations, advancing Taiwan toward its 2050 net‑zero emissions target.

items.title: 〈數位至匯登興櫃〉今年跨境匯款將衝破500億元 三大引擎驅動明年營收看增逾5成
items.title_en: Digital-to-Remittance (OTC) to List on Emerging Board; Cross-Border Remittances Expected to Exceed NT$50 Billion This Year, Three Engines Drive Over 50% Revenue Growth Next Year
paras: 隨著在台移工人數攀升、跨境小額匯兌需求擴大，數位至匯(7973-TW)營運展現強勁爆發力，今年前10月自結營收與營業利益雙雙超越去年全年水準，毛利率約 6 成，全年跨境匯款金額更可望突破500億元大關。數位至匯將於25日以每股參考價120元登錄興櫃，以跨境金融、移工經濟與AI金融科技為三大成長引擎，從移工匯款與生活生態圈出發，進一步跨足銀行與金融機構企業端AI解決方案，力拚明年營收延續逾 5 成的高成長動能。
數位至匯前身為2004年成立的數位行銷團隊，2022年初完成管理層收購並轉型聚焦跨境匯款與移工經濟，2023年取得金管會外籍移工國外小額匯兌業務許可，成為國內第三家持牌業者，印尼子公司亦持有印尼央行資金移轉執照，具備台、印雙地持牌優勢。
公司旗下擁有indoGo、go.vn及GoPadala三大品牌，分別服務印尼、越南與菲律賓移工，整合App、超商代收與跨國金融機構資源，透過雙地自主收付機制降低交易成本並縮短到帳時間。
在用戶經營上，數位至匯指出，匯款App基本功能易被複製，競爭關鍵除匯率與手續費外，更在於能否於匯款需求產生第一時間接觸用戶並建立使用習慣。數位至匯透過App、YouTube與社群平台，結合東南亞音樂、演唱會與線下活動貼近移工族群，今年App下載量已逾21.7萬次，並與秀泰影城交叉持股、結合新光三越台北車站據點等線上線下資源，強化會員黏著度與獲客效率。

財務表現方面，數位至匯2024年、2025年營收分別為2.22億元與3.96億元，年增78.5%，2025年每股純益(EPS)達10.28元；今年前10月自結稅後純益1.67億元，毛利率由2025年的56%提升至59%，營業利益率更由2024年的20.5%、2025年的33.6%拉升至約39.6%。跨境匯款金額則自2023年10億元攀升至2024年99億元、2025年240億元，兩年擴大24倍，今年全年可望突破500億元。
展望後市，隨台灣產業與長照人力缺口擴大，預估2028年在台移工人數將突破100萬人，外籍移工匯兌市場規模可達2,400億至2,700億元，未來三年年複合成長率逾12%；2026年台灣移工生活消費市場規模亦約2,179億元。
董事長暨執行長魏仁裕表示，目前匯款仍占營收九成以上，移工消費與生活服務占不到一成，但隨著會員基礎擴大，公司正積極切入電商、生活繳費、票券及先買後付(BNPL)等服務，並將金融與生活服務延伸至移工母國，明年期許延續過往50%以上的成長動能，且因人力等主要成本具規模效益，毛利率可望逐步向上。
數位至匯已將AI應用於資金排程與配置、洗錢防制警示分級(降低假警報干擾)及精準行銷；今年並策略投資金融資訊系統業者亞勤，借重其逾15年金融資訊系統經驗及逾10家銀行與金控客戶基礎，結合國際金融資訊與交易系統合作資源，將AI解決方案導入銀行交易室與風控流程，開拓系統建置、模組授權與訂閱營收，打造2C與2B雙軌並進的跨境金融科技平台。
paras_en: As the number of migrant workers in Taiwan rises and demand for small‑value cross‑border remittances expands, Digital‑to‑Remittance (7973‑TW) has shown strong explosive growth. In the first ten months of this year its revenue and operating profit both surpassed last year’s full‑year levels, with a gross margin of about 60%. The total cross‑border remittance volume for the year is expected to break the NT$50 billion mark. The company will list on the Emerging Board on the 25th at a reference price of NT$120 per share, leveraging cross‑border finance, the migrant‑worker economy and AI fintech as three growth engines. Starting from migrant‑worker remittances and a lifestyle ecosystem, it will further expand into AI solutions for banks and financial institutions, aiming to sustain a revenue growth momentum of more than 50% next year.

Originally founded in 2004 as a digital marketing team, Digital‑to‑Remittance completed a management buyout early in 2022 and shifted focus to cross‑border remittances and the migrant‑worker economy. In 2023 it obtained a licence from the Financial Supervisory Commission to provide small‑value overseas remittance services for foreign workers, becoming the third licensed provider in Taiwan. Its Indonesian subsidiary also holds a fund‑transfer licence from Bank Indonesia, giving the group a dual‑licence advantage in both Taiwan and Indonesia.

The company operates three main brands—indoGo, go.vn and GoPadala—serving migrant workers in Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines respectively. By integrating an app, convenience‑store collection points and cross‑border financial institution networks, it uses a dual‑location autonomous settlement mechanism to lower transaction costs and shorten settlement times.

Regarding user acquisition, Digital‑to‑Remittance notes that basic remittance‑app functions are easily copied, so competition hinges not only on exchange rates and fees but also on reaching users at the moment they need to remit and building habitual usage. The firm combines its app, YouTube and social platforms with Southeast Asian music, concerts and offline events to stay close to the migrant‑worker community. This year its app has been downloaded over 217,000 times. It also holds a cross‑shareholding with Showtime Cinemas and partners with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s Taipei Station outlet, among other online‑offline resources, to boost member stickiness and acquisition efficiency.

Financially, Digital‑to‑Remittance projects revenue of NT$2.22 billion in 2024 and NT$3.96 billion in 2025, a 78.5% year‑over‑year increase, with earnings per share of NT$10.28 in 2025. For the first ten months of this year it reported after‑tax profit of NT$1.67 billion, with gross margin rising from 56% in 2025 to 59%, and operating margin climbing from 20.5% in 2024 and 33.6% in 2025 to about 39.6%. Cross‑border remittance volume grew from NT$10 billion in 2023 to NT$99 billion in 2024 and NT$240 billion in 2025—a 24‑fold increase over two years—forecast to exceed NT$50 billion for the full year.

Looking ahead, as Taiwan’s industry and long‑term care sectors face growing labour shortages, the number of migrant workers in Taiwan is projected to surpass one million by 2028, expanding the foreign‑worker remittance market to NT$240 billion‑NT$270 billion with a compound annual growth rate of over 12% for the next three years. The domestic consumption market of migrant workers is also estimated at about NT$217.9 billion in 2026.

Chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu said that remittances currently account for over 90% of revenue, while migrant‑worker consumption and lifestyle services make up less than 10%. As the member base grows, the company is actively entering e‑commerce, utility payments, ticketing and buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) services, and extending financial and lifestyle offerings to workers’ home countries. He expects to maintain the historical >50% growth rate next year, and thanks to scale economies in labour and other major costs, gross margins should gradually improve.

Digital‑to‑Remittance has applied AI to cash‑flow scheduling and allocation, anti‑money‑laundering alert tiering (reducing false‑positive noise) and precision marketing. This year it strategically invested in financial‑information‑system provider iX, leveraging iX’s more than 15 years of experience and its client base of over ten banks and financial holding companies. By combining international financial data and trading‑system partnerships, the firm is introducing AI solutions into bank trading rooms and risk‑control processes, opening new revenue streams from system implementation, module licensing and subscriptions, and building a dual‑track (B2C and B2B) cross‑border fintech platform.

items.title: 網易Q3財報不佳引發港股股價暴跌 丁磊：短劇短期對遊戲帶來影響
items.title_en: NetEase Q3 Earnings Miss Triggers Hong Kong Stock Plunge; Ding Lei: Short-Form Drama Impacts Games Only Briefly
paras: 中國大陸遊戲巨頭網易(09999-HK)(NTES-US)公布第三季財務業績，因核心遊戲業務營收罕見出現衰退，業績全面低於市場預期，引發資本市場劇烈震盪。
受財報衝擊，網易港股周五(20日)盤中暴跌逾19%，創下近19個月以來股價新低，收盤大跌17.6%，美股存託憑證(ADS)前夜大跌11.39%，反映出投資人對遊戲產業成長動能放緩的深切疑慮。
根據網易公布數據，第三季公司總營收為279億元人民幣，年減1.8%；歸屬於公司股東的淨利為84億元人民幣，扣除非公認會計準則(Non-GAAP)後淨利為92億元人民幣，雙雙較去年同期下滑。
其中，作為網易營收支柱的「遊戲及相關增值服務」營收為229億元人民幣，年減1.7%、季減高達8%，此為2024年第三季以來首次出現年減衰退。
其他業務方面，有道營收年減12.3%，網易雲音樂年減0.9%，僅創新及其他業務逆勢年增7.1%。儘管營收承壓，網易透過精簡行銷與行政支出，第三季營業利潤率提升至36.6%，展現出費用控制效果。
針對業績表現，外資法人摩根大通發布最新研報指出，網易第三季總營收與調整後淨利分別低於市場預期8%與13%。
摩根大通分析，市場對網易2026年的營收與獲利預測可能面臨下修風險，在重磅新遊戲《海之遺忘》(Sea of Oblivion)等項目的國際發行時程明確前，短期股價將維持區間震盪。不過，鑑於公司財務狀況整體維持健康，摩根大通仍維持其「優於大盤」的投資評等與280港元的目標價。
面對市場變化，網易執行長丁磊在業績電話會議中表示，公司持續投入打造優質遊戲內容，並精細準備涵蓋多種類型與平台的新作管線。
針對微短劇對遊戲產業的衝擊，丁磊認為：「短期內會有影響，但長期來看兩者的娛樂體驗存在明顯差異。遊戲本身的樂趣在於操控與反饋，而短劇主要是劇情敘事上的吸引力。」丁磊同時強調，AI技術的引進將有效提升遊戲生產效率，推動內容邁向多樣化。
paras_en: Chinese mainland gaming giant NetEase (09999-HK)(NTES-US) released its third‑quarter financial results, which showed a rare decline in core gaming revenue and overall performance that fell short of market expectations, sparking severe turbulence in the capital markets.

Hit by the earnings shock, NetEase’s Hong Kong shares tumbled more than 19% during Friday’s (the 20th) trading, hitting a 19‑month low and closing down 17.6%, while its U.S. ADRs slid 11.39% after hours, reflecting investors’ deep concerns about slowing growth momentum in the gaming sector.

According to NetEase’s disclosed data, total revenue for the quarter was RMB 27.9 billion, down 1.8% year‑on‑year; net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.4 billion, and non‑GAAP net profit was RMB 9.2 billion, both lower than the same period last year.

Gaming and related value‑added services, the main revenue pillar for NetEase, generated RMB 22.9 billion, down 1.7% year‑on‑year and a steep 8% quarter‑on‑quarter decline, marking the first year‑over‑year contraction since Q3 2024.

In other segments, Youdao revenue fell 12.3% year‑on‑year, NetEase Cloud Music slipped 0.9%, while innovation and other businesses grew 7.1% year‑on‑year despite revenue pressure; NetEase improved its operating margin to 36.6% in Q3 by tightening marketing and administrative expenses, showing effective cost control.

Commenting on the performance, foreign institutional investor JPMorgan released a research note stating that NetEase’s Q3 total revenue and adjusted net profit missed market forecasts by 8% and 13% respectively.

JPMorgan analysts warned that revenue and profit forecasts for NetEase in 2026 could be at risk of downward revisions, and until the international rollout schedule for heavyweight new titles such as “Sea of Oblivion” is clarified, the stock is likely to remain range‑bound in the short term. Nonetheless, given the company’s overall healthy financial condition, JPMorgan maintains an “outperform” rating and a target price of HK$280.

Facing market changes, NetEase CEO Ding Lei said in the earnings call that the company continues to invest in high‑quality game content and is meticulously preparing a pipeline of new titles across multiple genres and platforms.

Regarding the impact of short‑form drama on the gaming industry, Ding Lei noted: “There will be short‑term effects, but in the long run the two entertainment experiences are clearly different. The fun of games lies in control and feedback, whereas short dramas mainly attract through narrative.” He also emphasized that the introduction of AI technology will boost game production efficiency and drive content diversification.

items.title: 神基三款強固型裝置通過Red Hat認證 擴大高度監管產業應用
items.title_en: Getac's Three Rugged Devices Earn Red Hat Certification, Expanding Use in Highly Regulated Industries
paras: 神基控股(3005-TW)旗下神基科技(Getac)今(20)日宣布，旗下UX10、G140及V120三款全強固型裝置，已通過Red Hat Enterprise Linux硬體認證，並列入Red Hat生態系統目錄。未來客戶可依據作業環境、IT架構及法規遵循需求，自行安裝部署Red Hat Enterprise Linux，為軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等高度監管產業提供更多作業系統選擇。
神基表示，此次通過認證的三款裝置，均已取得Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2及後續10.x版本認證，包含10.1吋全強固型平板UX10、14吋全強固型平板G140，以及12.2吋全強固型筆電V120。
由於相同硬體平台可支援Red Hat Enterprise Linux與Windows兩種作業系統，企業IT團隊可依不同部署環境的作業需求及法規遵循標準，彈性選擇適合的作業系統，同時維持強固型裝置部署與管理的一致性。Red Hat Enterprise Linux則由客戶自行安裝，方便IT團隊依既有系統配置及安全政策進行部署。
神基指出，軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等產業，對敏感資料保護及資訊安全有較高要求，相關標準也必須延伸至第一線作業環境。Red Hat Enterprise Linux具備多層安全防護機制，包括安全優先的預設配置、最小權限存取控制，以及可於系統建置階段套用的安全設定檔，協助企業符合相關法規及內部安全政策。
此外，Red Hat Enterprise Linux的長期支援週期，也與神基強固型裝置的長期可靠性相互配合，符合軍事國防及關鍵基礎設施產業較長的採購與部署時程，有助延長裝置使用年限，並降低總持有成本(TCO)。
神基控股暨神基科技董事長黃明漢表示，關鍵任務的執行不會止步於網路邊緣，安全防護標準也不應受到限制。對軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等客戶而言，第一線裝置不應成為資料中心既有IT安全政策的例外，透過Red Hat Enterprise Linux認證，可將既有平台的安全標準從伺服器機房延伸至第一線作業環境，並部署於專為嚴苛環境打造的全強固型硬體裝置。
paras_en: Getac, a subsidiary of Getac Holdings (3005‑TW), announced today that its three fully rugged devices—the UX10, G140 and V120—have passed Red Hat Enterprise Linux hardware certification and are now listed in the Red Hat ecosystem catalog. Customers can install and deploy Red Hat Enterprise Linux themselves according to their operating environment, IT architecture and regulatory compliance needs, offering more OS choices for highly regulated sectors such as defense, public safety and utilities.

Getac said the three certified devices have all received certification for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2 and subsequent 10.x releases, covering the 10.1‑inch fully rugged tablet UX10, the 14‑inch fully rugged tablet G140 and the 12.2‑inch fully rugged laptop V120.

Because the same hardware platform supports both Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows, enterprise IT teams can flexibly choose the operating system that best fits the deployment scenario and compliance standards while maintaining consistent deployment and management of rugged devices. Red Hat Enterprise Linux is installed by the customer, allowing IT teams to deploy it in line with existing system configurations and security policies.

Getac noted that sectors such as defense, public safety and utilities have heightened requirements for protecting sensitive data and information security, and related standards must extend to frontline operating environments. Red Hat Enterprise Linux provides multi‑layer security mechanisms, including security‑first default settings, least‑privilege access controls, and security configuration files that can be applied during system build, helping enterprises meet relevant regulations and internal security policies.

In addition, the long‑term support lifecycle of Red Hat Enterprise Linux aligns with the long‑term reliability of Getac’s rugged devices, matching the extended procurement and deployment timelines typical of defense and critical infrastructure projects. This synergy helps extend device service life and lower total cost of ownership (TCO).

Chairman Huang Ming‑Han of Getac Holdings and Getac Technology said that executing critical missions does not stop at the network edge, and security standards should not be constrained. For defense, public safety and utility customers, frontline devices should not be exceptions to existing data‑center IT security policies. By achieving Red Hat Enterprise Linux certification, existing platform security standards can be extended from server rooms to frontline environments and deployed on fully rugged hardware built for harsh conditions.

items.title: 台股跌跌不休 林修銘信心喊話：基本面穩健、AI中長期仍看俏
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Keep Falling, Lin Hsiu-Ming Says Confidence: Fundamentals Solid, AI Still Promising Long‑Term
paras: 台股跌跌不休，今(20)日終場大跌2,393.6點或6.23%，收在36,033.29點，不僅創下近7個月新低，更寫下台股史上第3大收盤跌點。面對市場波動加劇，臺灣證券交易所董事長林修銘對市場信心喊話，強調短期市場波動不改台灣產業基本面與長期競爭優勢，呼籲投資人回歸基本面理性看待，證交所也將持續強化市場韌性與交易安全。
林修銘指出，台灣資本市場與國際市場連結緊密，短期難免受到國際政經情勢及市場情緒影響，但台灣企業歷經美中貿易紛爭、新冠疫情及全球供應鏈重組等挑戰，持續透過技術創新與全球布局，展現高度應變能力與產業韌性。
針對市場關注的AI產業前景，林修銘表示，從國際科技大廠財報及投資規劃觀察，全球AI運算及基礎建設需求仍具中長期成長空間。他強調，台灣從半導體製造、先進封裝到AI伺服器及系統整合均具深厚實力，形成多年累積的完整產業生態系，國際AI大廠持續擴大與台廠合作，凸顯台灣在全球科技供應鏈的關鍵地位。
在總體經濟與上市櫃營運表現上，證交所列出多項數據指出基本面仍具成長動能：台灣今年前三季經濟成長率達14.22%，上市公司前10月營收年增近四成，前三季稅前淨利更年增超過八成。林修銘呼籲投資人面對短期波動時，更應回歸企業基本面，對台灣產業的長期競爭力保持信心。
在市場風險與交易秩序方面，林修銘強調，維護市場交易秩序與安全是證交所最重要的責任。據證交所觀察，集中市場融資餘額較上月高點減少逾1,500億元，顯示市場槓桿部位持續調整；違約交割及融資追繳處分情形目前尚未出現明顯異常。證交所將持續強化市場監視與風險管理機制，密切掌握交易動態與風險指標，並與主管機關合作，如發現異常將依權責即時處理。
金管會昨(19)日已宣布自 20 日起實施新一波市場穩定措施，適度限制跌幅較大個股次一交易日的融券及借券賣出價格，並調降借券賣出委託數量上限，以減緩短期集中賣壓。林修銘說明，相關措施並非全面禁止放空，投資人仍可依規定進行融券、借券賣出及運用衍生性商品避險，兼顧正常交易需求與市場穩定，證交所也將持續觀察情勢並配合主管機關適時檢討調整。
此外，林修銘表示，市場信心需要充分的資訊揭露與良好的企業溝通。證交所將持續督促上市公司落實重大資訊揭露，鼓勵企業主動說明營運成果、經營策略與未來展望，並鼓勵公司在衡酌財務狀況與股東權益後，適時評估實施庫藏股，展現對長期經營的信心。同時，證交所也會加強關注市場不實消息，若媒體報導或市場觀念有所偏誤，將適時對外提供正確完整說明，並與主管機關及各界攜手推動資本市場長期穩健發展。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market continued its decline, ending the day (20th) down 2,393.6 points or 6.23% at 36,033.29 points, not only hitting a seven‑month low but also recording the third‑largest closing point drop in Taiwan market history. Facing heightened market volatility, Taiwan Stock Exchange Chairman Lin Hsiu‑Ming voiced confidence in the market, stressing that short‑term swings do not change the solid fundamentals and long‑term competitive advantages of Taiwan’s industries, urging investors to return to fundamentals and view the market rationally, while the exchange will keep strengthening market resilience and trading safety.

Lin noted that Taiwan’s capital market is closely linked to international markets, so short‑term fluctuations are inevitably influenced by global political‑economic conditions and market sentiment. Nevertheless, Taiwanese companies have weathered challenges such as the US‑China trade dispute, the COVID‑19 pandemic, and global supply‑chain restructuring, continuously leveraging technological innovation and global expansion to demonstrate strong adaptability and industry resilience.

Addressing concerns about the AI sector’s outlook, Lin said that, based on the financial reports and investment plans of major international tech firms, global demand for AI computing and infrastructure still has medium‑ to long‑term growth potential. He emphasized that Taiwan possesses deep capabilities across semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, AI servers and system integration, forming a mature, multi‑year‑built ecosystem. International AI giants are expanding cooperation with Taiwanese firms, highlighting Taiwan’s pivotal role in the global tech supply chain.

Regarding overall economic and listed‑company performance, the exchange cited several data points showing continued growth momentum: Taiwan’s GDP grew 14.22% in the first three quarters of this year, the top‑10 listed companies saw revenue increase by nearly 40% year‑on‑year through October, and pre‑tax profit for the first three quarters rose by over 80% year‑on‑year. Lin urged investors, amid short‑term volatility, to focus on corporate fundamentals and maintain confidence in the long‑term competitiveness of Taiwan’s industries.

On market risk and trading order, Lin stressed that safeguarding trading order and safety is the exchange’s top responsibility. Observations show that margin financing balances in the centralized market fell by more than NT$150 billion from last month’s peak, indicating ongoing adjustment of leveraged positions; no obvious anomalies have appeared in default deliveries or margin calls. The exchange will continue to enhance market surveillance and risk‑management mechanisms, closely monitor trading dynamics and risk indicators, and cooperate with regulators to address any irregularities promptly.

The Financial Supervisory Commission announced on the 19th that new market‑stabilizing measures would take effect on the 20th, modestly limiting short‑selling and borrowing‑sell prices for stocks that fell sharply the previous day and lowering the ceiling on borrowing‑sell order quantities to ease concentrated selling pressure. Lin clarified that these measures do not constitute a blanket short‑selling ban; investors may still engage in margin borrowing, short‑selling and use derivatives for hedging, balancing normal trading needs with market stability. The exchange will keep monitoring the situation and work with regulators to adjust measures as needed.

Finally, Lin said market confidence requires ample information disclosure and good corporate communication. The exchange will keep urging listed companies to fulfill major information‑disclosure obligations, encourage firms to proactively explain operating results, strategies and outlook, and, after weighing financial conditions and shareholder interests, consider timely share‑buybacks to demonstrate confidence in long‑term operations. The exchange will also strengthen monitoring of false market rumors and, if media reports or market perceptions are misleading, provide accurate explanations and collaborate with regulators and stakeholders to promote the long‑term healthy development of the capital market.

items.title: 〈數位至匯登興櫃〉從半導體、創投轉戰移工匯兌 引進台達電等長線資金打造服務生態圈
items.title_en: Digital-to-Remittance to List on the Emerging Stock Board, Shifting from Semiconductors and Venture Capital to Migrant Worker Remittances, Attracting Long‑Term Capital like Delta Electronics to Build a Service Ecosystem
paras: 從半導體、電子材料到私募創投，數位至匯(7973-TW)董事長暨執行長魏仁裕在2022年初正式掌舵後，選擇一條看似冷門卻緊扣台灣產業缺工趨勢的賽道—移工跨境金融。他指出，這段跨界創業並非來自精算後的商業評估，而是早年家中聘請外籍看護照顧生病父親時，陪著移工匯款、逛印尼店的日常體悟。
數位至匯即將登錄興櫃，董事長暨執行長魏仁裕談起跨足移工跨境金融的起點，「做生意不能只看短線獲利，更要站在服務移工的出發點，幫他們在台安穩生活、照顧家人。」這個創業的起心動念源自早年照顧生病父親、陪伴外籍看護匯款與逛印尼店的日常經驗，他進而看見移工在台工作、匯款與生活的真實需求。
魏仁裕過去在科技與材料領域的經歷，主要集中於面板光學材料與電子量測儀器／半導體設備，同時也橫跨創投與私募股權投資。他 2021 年底買下公司、2022 年初正式掌舵。在股權結構上，他引進台達電、佳世達等產業資金及零售通路、金融業股東，就是看重長期資金的穩定性，而非創投的短期出場壓力；公司內部亦維持扁平化組織架構，讓團隊在取得執照與開辦多國業務上得以快速反應。
談及市場競爭與移工處境，魏仁裕指出，目前合法持牌業者前幾大合計市占率已具相當規模，各家策略各有不同，而市場上推估仍有約20%至30%的黑市或地下匯兌空間，加上越南今年初加強管控地下匯兌，使當地合規匯款成長加速。
至於泰國與印度等市場，公司則視法規開放進度與資源配置審慎推進。在客戶結構上，印尼以家事移工為主、越南多為廠工、菲律賓各半，隨著各國匯款均穩健成長，菲律賓與越南近期成長力道尤為顯著。
針對移工來台前常須向當地仲介或高利借貸、背負沉重債務的現象，魏仁裕透露，公司憑藉在台會員基礎與印尼當地執照及銀行合作網絡，正推動跨境延伸服務與先買後付(BNPL)機制，協助減輕移工還款與消費負擔，同時希望透過合法、透明的金融管道，降低移工遭剝削的風險。
魏仁裕也特別把焦點轉向移工在台面臨的另一項難題，部分移工在台生下孩子卻缺乏身分。他提到，像是文山區「關愛之家」等機構收容了不少無國籍或身分不明的幼童，因法令限制，這些孩子無法長期留在台灣，也面臨返國銜接的挑戰，期盼社會與政府相關單位能給予更多關注與協助，讓孩子們能在適齡階段回到母國獲得妥善照顧。
paras_en: After moving from semiconductors, electronic materials and private‑equity venture capital, Digital-to-Remittance (7973‑TW) chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu took the helm in early 2022 and chose a seemingly niche but tightly linked track to Taiwan’s labor shortage trend—cross‑border finance for migrant workers. He said the venture was not born from actuarial business analysis but from personal experience helping a foreign caregiver remit money and shop at Indonesian stores while caring for his sick father.

Digital-to-Remittance is about to list on the Emerging Stock Board. Chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu explained the starting point of entering migrant‑worker cross‑border finance: “Doing business cannot focus only on short‑term profit; it must start from serving migrant workers, helping them live stably in Taiwan and support their families.” This entrepreneurial motive stemmed from his early experience caring for his ill father and accompanying a foreign caregiver in remitting funds and shopping in Indonesia, where he recognized the real needs of migrant workers in Taiwan for work, remittance and daily life.

Wei’s background in technology and materials was mainly in panel optical materials, electronic measurement instruments and semiconductor equipment, while also spanning venture capital and private‑equity investing. He bought the company at the end of 2021 and officially took charge in early 2022. In the equity structure he brought in industry capital and shareholders from Delta Electronics, Qisda and retail and financial sectors, valuing the stability of long‑term funding over the short‑term exit pressure of venture capital; the company also maintains a flat organizational structure, enabling the team to react quickly in obtaining licenses and launching multi‑country operations.

Regarding market competition and migrant‑worker conditions, Wei noted that the top licensed operators already command a sizable combined market share, each pursuing different strategies. Nonetheless, the market is estimated to still have about 20%‑30% of black‑market or underground remittance space, and Vietnam’s tightened crackdown on underground remittances earlier this year has accelerated growth in compliant transfers there.

For markets such as Thailand and India, the company proceeds cautiously based on regulatory openness and resource allocation. In terms of customer composition, Indonesia is dominated by domestic‑helper migrants, Vietnam mainly by factory workers, and the Philippines is split roughly half‑and‑half. As remittances from all countries grow steadily, recent growth momentum is especially strong in the Philippines and Vietnam.

Addressing the common issue of migrants incurring high‑interest loans or heavy debt through local agents before coming to Taiwan, Wei revealed that the company, leveraging its member base in Taiwan and its Indonesian license and banking network, is rolling out cross‑border extended services and a buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) mechanism to ease repayment and consumption burdens. The aim is also to reduce exploitation risk by providing legal, transparent financial channels.

Wei also highlighted another challenge faced by migrant workers in Taiwan: some have children born locally but lack legal status. He mentioned that facilities such as the “Caring Home” in Wenshan District shelter many stateless or undocumented children. Because of legal restrictions, these children cannot stay long‑term in Taiwan and face difficulties returning to their home countries. He hopes society and relevant government agencies will give more attention and assistance so the children can receive proper care when they return to their mothers’ countries at an appropriate age.

items.title: 群聯推太空專用SSD搶攻軌道資料中心市場 攜手Lonestar明年上半年發射升空
items.title_en: Phison Launches Space‑Specific SSD to Target Orbital Data Center Market, Partners with Lonestar for Launch in Early 2027
paras: NAND控制晶片廠群聯(8299-TW)今(20)日宣布推出全新Pascari Space太空專用SSD解決方案，正式拓展商業太空應用及太空軌道基礎設施儲存市場。其中，群聯將攜手美國太空資料中心業者Lonestar Data Holdings，支援其首個商業軌道資料中心節點StarVault-001，預計2027年上半年發射升空，屆時將搭載488TB群聯Pascari Space SSD，提供約370TB可用儲存容量。
群聯指出，隨著太空發射成本持續下降，太空軌道基礎設施及衛星應用逐步發展，加上地面資料中心面臨電力消耗、散熱、空間及天然災害等挑戰，市場對高可靠度、高效能太空儲存技術的需求也持續增加，應用涵蓋環境監測、森林砍伐防治、太空探索及科學研究等領域。
群聯表示，Pascari Space建立於超過26年的NAND儲存技術研發經驗，並結合旗下IMAGIN+客製化NAND儲存解決方案與ASIC設計服務，可依不同太空任務需求，針對元件選擇、韌體、耐用度、資料保存能力及抗輻射能力等進行客製化設計。

群聯過去已將儲存技術導入NASA火星探測車，並於2025年與Lonestar合作，將資料中心硬體部署於月球，相關技術已達技術成熟度第9級(TRL-9)。此次推出的Pascari Space進一步依任務需求區分為三大產品線，包括著重可靠度及系統韌性的Flight Critical飛行關鍵型儲存、兼顧效能與耐用度的Main Storage主儲存，以及滿足大量資料需求的Orbital Data Center太空軌道資料中心儲存。
在技術方面，Pascari Space透過群聯自主研發的控制晶片及韌體，提供最高可達60倍的耐用度提升，並導入資料清理(Data Scrubbing)及隨機化RAID映射設計。此外，也整合LDPC錯誤更正碼、SmartECC、SmartRefresh及SRAM交錯技術，提升資料完整性與系統可靠度。
針對太空環境中的輻射風險，群聯也提供總游離輻射劑量(TID)及單粒子效應(SEE)等輻射特性分析服務，涵蓋重離子測試及產品製造後的批次測試，協助客戶依不同任務需求強化儲存設備的環境耐受能力。
群聯執行長潘健成表示，太空正迅速成為下一個重要的資料基礎設施發展領域，但太空SSD在飛行任務中面臨的挑戰，遠高於地面系統。透過Pascari Space系列，群聯將儲存技術延伸至太空領域，讓客戶可依不同任務需求客製化儲存方案，從飛行安全相關的關鍵儲存系統，到太空軌道資料中心，協助建構下一世代太空基礎設施。
此次合作的Lonestar Data Holdings創辦人Chris Stott指出，資料是支撐全球經濟、企業營運及AI工作流程的重要基礎，透過StarVault，將在地球之外建構安全且具自主掌控能力的資料基礎設施，降低地面環境風險，並為未來太空中的AI與運算服務奠定基礎，而群聯儲存技術是StarVault架構中的重要一環。
paras_en: Phison (8299‑TW) announced today that it is introducing a brand‑new Pascari Space SSD solution designed for space, formally expanding into the commercial space‑application and orbital‑infrastructure storage markets. Phison will partner with U.S. space‑data‑center operator Lonestar Data Holdings to support its first commercial orbital data‑center node, StarVault‑001, slated for launch in the first half of 2027 and equipped with 488 TB of Phison Pascari Space SSDs, delivering roughly 370 TB of usable capacity.

Phison noted that as launch costs continue to fall, orbital infrastructure and satellite applications are maturing, while terrestrial data centers face challenges such as power consumption, heat dissipation, space constraints and natural‑disaster risk. Consequently, demand for highly reliable, high‑performance space storage technology is growing, with applications ranging from environmental monitoring and forest‑preservation to space exploration and scientific research.

Phison said the Pascari Space line builds on more than 26 years of NAND storage R&D and combines its IMAGIN+ custom NAND storage solutions with ASIC design services, allowing component selection, firmware, durability, data‑retention and radiation‑hardening to be tailored to the specific needs of each space mission.

Phison has previously supplied storage technology to NASA’s Mars rovers and, in 2025, partnered with Lonestar to deploy data‑center hardware on the Moon, achieving Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL‑9). The new Pascari Space portfolio is divided into three product lines based on mission requirements: the Flight‑Critical line for maximum reliability and system resilience, the Main Storage line balancing performance and durability, and the Orbital Data Center line for high‑volume data storage needs.

Technically, Pascari Space leverages Phison’s in‑house controller chips and firmware to deliver up to 60× endurance improvement, incorporates data‑scrubbing and randomized RAID mapping, and integrates LDPC error‑correction, SmartECC, SmartRefresh and SRAM interleaving to boost data integrity and system reliability.

To address radiation hazards in space, Phison also offers total ionizing dose (TID) and single‑event effect (SEE) analysis services, including heavy‑ion testing and post‑manufacturing batch testing, helping customers enhance the environmental tolerance of their storage devices for specific missions.

Phison CEO Pan Chien‑cheng said space is rapidly becoming the next critical data‑infrastructure frontier, but space SSDs face far greater challenges than ground‑based systems. With the Pascari Space series, Phison extends its storage expertise to space, enabling customers to customize solutions from flight‑critical storage to orbital data centers and help build the next‑generation space infrastructure.

Lonestar Data Holdings founder Chris Stott said data underpins the global economy, enterprise operations and AI workflows. Through StarVault, Lonestar aims to build secure, sovereign data infrastructure beyond Earth, reducing ground‑environment risks and laying the groundwork for future AI and compute services in space, with Phison’s storage technology playing a key role in the StarVault architecture.

items.title: 碳交所攜手證交所響應「氣候倡議敲鐘」聚焦能源管理與循環經濟、加速企業低碳轉型
items.title_en: Carbon Exchange Partners with Stock Exchange to Respond to “Ring the Bell for Climate,” Focusing on Energy Management and Circular Economy, Accelerating Corporate Low‑Carbon Transformation
paras: 為協助企業落實低碳轉型，證交所於本(11)月4日攜手碳交所及碳權研究與管理服務中心，共同舉辦「企業實質減碳策略與實務 Ⅰ & Ⅱ」講座。課程聚焦能源管理與循環經濟兩大主題，透過專業知識與實務經驗分享，協助企業掌握提升能源使用效率及促進資源循環利用的策略，將減碳目標融入日常管理與營運決策，逐步建立符合自身需求的減碳路徑。
證交所為持續發揮資本市場推動永續轉型的角色，今(2026)年再度響應世界交易所聯合會(WFE)發起的「氣候倡議敲鐘」(Ring the Bell for Climate)活動，今年適逢第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會(COP31)召開，證交所透過推廣企業減碳實務，以具體行動展現臺灣資本市場對全球氣候倡議的支持。
為營造健全的永續發展生態系，是證交所推動資本市場發展的重要方向。證交所持續從強化公司治理、提升永續資訊揭露品質及支持企業轉型等面向推進，並結合碳交所與相關專業機構的資源，協助企業在永續資訊揭露與能力建構的基礎上，進一步落實減碳策略，將永續管理融入經營布局，厚植臺灣資本市場的長期競爭力。
今年第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會(COP31)於11月9日至20日在土耳其召開，重點聚焦加速落實全球氣候行動，將氣候承諾轉化為具體且可衡量的成果。呼應此一方向，證交所響應WFE氣候倡議，從企業實質減碳需求出發，推動能源管理與循環經濟的實務交流。未來將持續關注氣候變遷議題，深化跨機構合作，支持企業將減碳策略落實於日常營運，為臺灣邁向2050淨零排放目標邁進。
paras_en: To help companies implement low‑carbon transformation, the Stock Exchange on November 4 held a joint seminar titled “Corporate Substantive Carbon‑Reduction Strategies and Practices I & II” together with the Carbon Exchange and the Carbon Rights Research and Management Service Center. The courses focused on two themes—energy management and the circular economy—and, through professional knowledge and practical experience sharing, assisted firms in mastering strategies to improve energy‑use efficiency and promote resource‑circulation utilization, integrating carbon‑reduction goals into daily management and operational decisions, and gradually establishing carbon‑reduction pathways that meet their own needs.

The Stock Exchange, continuing to play its role in driving sustainable transformation via the capital market, again responded this year (2026) to the World Federation of Exchanges’ (WFE) “Ring the Bell for Climate” initiative. Coinciding with the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31), the exchange showcases Taiwan’s capital market support for global climate initiatives by promoting corporate carbon‑reduction practices through concrete actions.

Creating a sound ecosystem for sustainable development is a key direction for the Stock Exchange’s market development. It continuously advances corporate governance, enhances the quality of sustainability disclosures, and supports corporate transformation. By leveraging resources from the Carbon Exchange and related professional bodies, the exchange helps companies not only improve sustainability reporting and capability building but also implement carbon‑reduction strategies, embedding sustainability management into business planning and strengthening the long‑term competitiveness of Taiwan’s capital market.

The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) was held in Turkey from November 9 to 20, focusing on accelerating global climate action and turning climate commitments into concrete, measurable results. Aligning with this direction, the Stock Exchange responded to the WFE climate initiative by promoting practical exchanges on energy management and the circular economy based on firms’ substantive carbon‑reduction needs. Going forward, it will continue to monitor climate‑change issues, deepen cross‑institutional cooperation, and support companies in embedding carbon‑reduction strategies into daily operations, advancing Taiwan toward its 2050 net‑zero emissions target.

items.title: 〈數位至匯登興櫃〉今年跨境匯款將衝破500億元 三大引擎驅動明年營收看增逾5成
items.title_en: Digital-to-Remittance (OTC) to List on Emerging Board; Cross-Border Remittances Expected to Exceed NT$50 Billion This Year, Three Engines Drive Over 50% Revenue Growth Next Year
paras: 隨著在台移工人數攀升、跨境小額匯兌需求擴大，數位至匯(7973-TW)營運展現強勁爆發力，今年前10月自結營收與營業利益雙雙超越去年全年水準，毛利率約 6 成，全年跨境匯款金額更可望突破500億元大關。數位至匯將於25日以每股參考價120元登錄興櫃，以跨境金融、移工經濟與AI金融科技為三大成長引擎，從移工匯款與生活生態圈出發，進一步跨足銀行與金融機構企業端AI解決方案，力拚明年營收延續逾 5 成的高成長動能。
數位至匯前身為2004年成立的數位行銷團隊，2022年初完成管理層收購並轉型聚焦跨境匯款與移工經濟，2023年取得金管會外籍移工國外小額匯兌業務許可，成為國內第三家持牌業者，印尼子公司亦持有印尼央行資金移轉執照，具備台、印雙地持牌優勢。
公司旗下擁有indoGo、go.vn及GoPadala三大品牌，分別服務印尼、越南與菲律賓移工，整合App、超商代收與跨國金融機構資源，透過雙地自主收付機制降低交易成本並縮短到帳時間。
在用戶經營上，數位至匯指出，匯款App基本功能易被複製，競爭關鍵除匯率與手續費外，更在於能否於匯款需求產生第一時間接觸用戶並建立使用習慣。數位至匯透過App、YouTube與社群平台，結合東南亞音樂、演唱會與線下活動貼近移工族群，今年App下載量已逾21.7萬次，並與秀泰影城交叉持股、結合新光三越台北車站據點等線上線下資源，強化會員黏著度與獲客效率。

財務表現方面，數位至匯2024年、2025年營收分別為2.22億元與3.96億元，年增78.5%，2025年每股純益(EPS)達10.28元；今年前10月自結稅後純益1.67億元，毛利率由2025年的56%提升至59%，營業利益率更由2024年的20.5%、2025年的33.6%拉升至約39.6%。跨境匯款金額則自2023年10億元攀升至2024年99億元、2025年240億元，兩年擴大24倍，今年全年可望突破500億元。
展望後市，隨台灣產業與長照人力缺口擴大，預估2028年在台移工人數將突破100萬人，外籍移工匯兌市場規模可達2,400億至2,700億元，未來三年年複合成長率逾12%；2026年台灣移工生活消費市場規模亦約2,179億元。
董事長暨執行長魏仁裕表示，目前匯款仍占營收九成以上，移工消費與生活服務占不到一成，但隨著會員基礎擴大，公司正積極切入電商、生活繳費、票券及先買後付(BNPL)等服務，並將金融與生活服務延伸至移工母國，明年期許延續過往50%以上的成長動能，且因人力等主要成本具規模效益，毛利率可望逐步向上。
數位至匯已將AI應用於資金排程與配置、洗錢防制警示分級(降低假警報干擾)及精準行銷；今年並策略投資金融資訊系統業者亞勤，借重其逾15年金融資訊系統經驗及逾10家銀行與金控客戶基礎，結合國際金融資訊與交易系統合作資源，將AI解決方案導入銀行交易室與風控流程，開拓系統建置、模組授權與訂閱營收，打造2C與2B雙軌並進的跨境金融科技平台。
paras_en: As the number of migrant workers in Taiwan rises and demand for small‑value cross‑border remittances expands, Digital‑to‑Remittance (7973‑TW) has shown strong explosive growth. In the first ten months of this year its revenue and operating profit both surpassed last year’s full‑year levels, with a gross margin of about 60%. The total cross‑border remittance volume for the year is expected to break the NT$50 billion mark. The company will list on the Emerging Board on the 25th at a reference price of NT$120 per share, leveraging cross‑border finance, the migrant‑worker economy and AI fintech as three growth engines. Starting from migrant‑worker remittances and a lifestyle ecosystem, it will further expand into AI solutions for banks and financial institutions, aiming to sustain a revenue growth momentum of more than 50% next year.

Originally founded in 2004 as a digital marketing team, Digital‑to‑Remittance completed a management buyout early in 2022 and shifted focus to cross‑border remittances and the migrant‑worker economy. In 2023 it obtained a licence from the Financial Supervisory Commission to provide small‑value overseas remittance services for foreign workers, becoming the third licensed provider in Taiwan. Its Indonesian subsidiary also holds a fund‑transfer licence from Bank Indonesia, giving the group a dual‑licence advantage in both Taiwan and Indonesia.

The company operates three main brands—indoGo, go.vn and GoPadala—serving migrant workers in Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines respectively. By integrating an app, convenience‑store collection points and cross‑border financial institution networks, it uses a dual‑location autonomous settlement mechanism to lower transaction costs and shorten settlement times.

Regarding user acquisition, Digital‑to‑Remittance notes that basic remittance‑app functions are easily copied, so competition hinges not only on exchange rates and fees but also on reaching users at the moment they need to remit and building habitual usage. The firm combines its app, YouTube and social platforms with Southeast Asian music, concerts and offline events to stay close to the migrant‑worker community. This year its app has been downloaded over 217,000 times. It also holds a cross‑shareholding with Showtime Cinemas and partners with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s Taipei Station outlet, among other online‑offline resources, to boost member stickiness and acquisition efficiency.

Financially, Digital‑to‑Remittance projects revenue of NT$2.22 billion in 2024 and NT$3.96 billion in 2025, a 78.5% year‑over‑year increase, with earnings per share of NT$10.28 in 2025. For the first ten months of this year it reported after‑tax profit of NT$1.67 billion, with gross margin rising from 56% in 2025 to 59%, and operating margin climbing from 20.5% in 2024 and 33.6% in 2025 to about 39.6%. Cross‑border remittance volume grew from NT$10 billion in 2023 to NT$99 billion in 2024 and NT$240 billion in 2025—a 24‑fold increase over two years—forecast to exceed NT$50 billion for the full year.

Looking ahead, as Taiwan’s industry and long‑term care sectors face growing labour shortages, the number of migrant workers in Taiwan is projected to surpass one million by 2028, expanding the foreign‑worker remittance market to NT$240 billion‑NT$270 billion with a compound annual growth rate of over 12% for the next three years. The domestic consumption market of migrant workers is also estimated at about NT$217.9 billion in 2026.

Chairman and CEO Wei Ren‑Yu said that remittances currently account for over 90% of revenue, while migrant‑worker consumption and lifestyle services make up less than 10%. As the member base grows, the company is actively entering e‑commerce, utility payments, ticketing and buy‑now‑pay‑later (BNPL) services, and extending financial and lifestyle offerings to workers’ home countries. He expects to maintain the historical >50% growth rate next year, and thanks to scale economies in labour and other major costs, gross margins should gradually improve.

Digital‑to‑Remittance has applied AI to cash‑flow scheduling and allocation, anti‑money‑laundering alert tiering (reducing false‑positive noise) and precision marketing. This year it strategically invested in financial‑information‑system provider iX, leveraging iX’s more than 15 years of experience and its client base of over ten banks and financial holding companies. By combining international financial data and trading‑system partnerships, the firm is introducing AI solutions into bank trading rooms and risk‑control processes, opening new revenue streams from system implementation, module licensing and subscriptions, and building a dual‑track (B2C and B2B) cross‑border fintech platform.

items.title: 雙11價格戰提前開打 台灣10月手機加速降價 iPhone 18 Pro大容量版單月下殺逾4千元
items.title_en: Double‑11 Price War Starts Early; Taiwan October Smartphone Prices Drop Faster, iPhone 18 Pro 2TB Slashed Over NT$4,000 in One Month
paras: 隨著年度最大網購盛事雙11的戰火提前點燃，各大通訊連鎖通路與電商平台不再等待11月才正式交鋒，而是直接在10月份全面提前開打價格戰。根據傑昇通信全台門市實際銷售統計顯示，近期新機上市首月集體面臨價格修正的罕見現象，使降幅收斂至2%至29%之間。
10月進榜的機型有多達十款是當月才剛開賣的新機，本月降價王是單月直降7千的vivo最新摺疊旗艦X Fold6、總降價冠軍由榮耀摺疊旗艦HONOR Magic V6降破1.3萬奪下、月降幅及總降幅達29%的雙冠王，則由平價新機OPPO A7 Pro（8GB/128GB）蟬聯。
進一步觀察10月降價排行，焦點莫過於vivo新機的強勢屠榜。vivo旗下全新摺疊旗艦X Fold6在十月一登場就拿下月降價冠軍，月降7,000元，展現極為強烈的搶市企圖心，同品牌的V80系列新機也包辦第二、三名，單月分別降價6,000元與5,000元，推升新機在上市首月就出現一至兩成以上的有感折價。
傑昇通信表示，vivo不僅打破過去傳統促銷節奏，更反映在面臨硬體成本持續飆漲的壓力時，品牌與通路為加速首波備貨去化與搶市佔率，不得不採取具侵略性的價格讓利策略。
而在上市累積總降價金額方面，同樣是10月上市的榮耀Magic V6竟累積降價高達1.3萬元，總降幅達兩成。
傑昇通信分析，摺疊機主要透過高額的絕對降價金額來吸引目標客群，又遇上通路在特定檔期針對新機釋出的首月讓利，讓全新機型一開賣就能出現幅度驚人的折價空間，尤其是動輒六萬元以上的天價極易引發消費者觀望，因此實體通路為加速首波高單價備貨的庫存周轉、避免資金積壓，便會在上市首月直接將原廠提供的行銷資源與銷售獎金轉換為現金折扣，透過破萬元的實質價差將成交門檻拉回五萬元甜蜜區間，藉此破冰並分食摺疊機市占。
除了高階旗艦與新機的價格交鋒外，中階平價市場的折舊表現亦充滿看點。在降幅百分比的表現上，OPPO A7 Pro（8GB/128GB）版本以高達29%的降幅，奪下月降幅、總降幅冠軍，換算實際金額降價4,000元，通路空機售價壓在萬元內，成為榜單中唯一的千元級平價機型。
傑昇通信指出，因雙11檔期提前開打的市場價格變動，就連中階平價機型也透過近三成的降幅來鎖定預算敏感型消費者，不僅是有意換機消費者的入場時機，也揭示手機市場在成本堆疊與買氣觀望雙重夾擊下的生存法則。
與此同時，蘋果iPhone 18 Pro系列的大舉進榜，更是整體產業面臨成本壓力與庫存調節縮影的最佳寫照。連續數月在降價榜全面缺席的蘋果，在十月份終於打破沉默，由iPhone 18 Pro系列一口氣佔四席，特別值得注意的是，降價的主力集中在大容量版本，其中iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max的2TB超大容量規格同步下殺4,010元，而512GB版本的空機價也跌破五萬元大關。
傑昇通信觀察，蘋果在九月份首波新機熱潮過後，出貨量為數不多的高單價大容量版本，庫存開始在實體通路釋放，隨著年底購物旺季正式展開，通路提前在雙11前夕發動有感讓利，才能出現價格鬆動的訊號。
paras_en: As the biggest annual online‑shopping event Double‑11 ignites ahead of schedule, major telecom retailers and e‑commerce platforms are no longer waiting until November to clash; they have launched a full‑blown price war in October. According to Jiesheng Communications’ sales data from all its stores nationwide, a rare phenomenon has emerged where newly launched models see price adjustments in their first month, with discounts ranging from 2% to 29%.

Ten models that entered the market in October were brand‑new releases, and the month’s biggest single‑month price cut belonged to vivo’s latest folding flagship X Fold 6, which dropped NT$7,000. The overall discount champion was Honor’s folding flagship Magic V6, which fell by more than NT$13,000, while the dual‑title holder for both monthly and total discount percentages (29%) was the budget newcomer OPPO A7 Pro (8 GB/128 GB).

Looking at the October discount rankings, the spotlight is on vivo’s strong performance. The brand‑new folding flagship X Fold 6 claimed the top spot for monthly discount in its debut month, falling NT$7,000, showing an aggressive market‑capture intent. The same brand’s V80 series took second and third places, with single‑month cuts of NT$6,000 and NT$5,000 respectively, pushing new‑model discounts in the first month to over 10‑20%.

Jiesheng Communications said that vivo not only broke the traditional promotion rhythm, but also, under pressure from soaring hardware costs, the brand and retailers had to adopt aggressive price‑rebate strategies to accelerate the first wave of inventory clearance and market share capture.
In terms of cumulative total discount amount, the Honor Magic V6, also launched in October, accumulated a price cut of up to NT$13,000, a total discount of about 20%.

Jiesheng Communications analysed that folding phones mainly attract target customers through large absolute discount amounts. When retailers offer first‑month rebates for new models during specific periods, the brand‑new devices can enjoy striking price cuts right out of the gate. Because flagship folding phones often exceed NT$60,000, consumers tend to hesitate; therefore, physical retailers convert the manufacturer’s marketing resources and sales bonuses into cash discounts in the first month, pulling the transaction threshold back to the NT$50,000 “sweet spot” with price differences of over NT$10,000, thus breaking the ice and carving out market share for folding phones.

Beyond the price battles among high‑end flagships and new releases, the mid‑range budget segment also shows interesting depreciation trends. In percentage terms, the OPPO A7 Pro (8 GB/128 GB) achieved a 29% drop, winning both the monthly and total discount titles, equivalent to a NT$4,000 price cut, with the empty‑box price staying under NT$10,000, making it the only sub‑NT$1,000‑level device on the list.

Jiesheng Communications noted that the early‑start Double‑11 price shifts even affected mid‑range budget phones, which used nearly a 30% discount to lock in price‑sensitive buyers. This not only creates an entry point for consumers looking to upgrade, but also reveals the survival rule of the smartphone market under the twin pressures of cost stacking and cautious demand.

Meanwhile, Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro series made a strong showing on the list, illustrating the industry’s cost‑pressure and inventory‑adjustment dynamics. After months of absence from the discount rankings, Apple finally broke the silence in October, occupying four spots with the iPhone 18 Pro line. The main discounts focused on the high‑capacity models: the 2‑TB versions of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max were each cut by NT$4,010, and the 512‑GB variant’s empty‑box price also fell below NT$50,000.

Jiesheng Communications observed that after the initial September surge of new iPhone models, the limited‑supply high‑price, high‑capacity versions began to appear in physical‑store inventory. With the year‑end shopping season kicking off, retailers launched noticeable rebates just before Double‑11, prompting the first signs of price flexibility.

items.title: 神基三款強固型裝置通過Red Hat認證 擴大高度監管產業應用
items.title_en: Getac's Three Rugged Devices Earn Red Hat Certification, Expanding Use in Highly Regulated Industries
paras: 神基控股(3005-TW)旗下神基科技(Getac)今(20)日宣布，旗下UX10、G140及V120三款全強固型裝置，已通過Red Hat Enterprise Linux硬體認證，並列入Red Hat生態系統目錄。未來客戶可依據作業環境、IT架構及法規遵循需求，自行安裝部署Red Hat Enterprise Linux，為軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等高度監管產業提供更多作業系統選擇。
神基表示，此次通過認證的三款裝置，均已取得Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2及後續10.x版本認證，包含10.1吋全強固型平板UX10、14吋全強固型平板G140，以及12.2吋全強固型筆電V120。
由於相同硬體平台可支援Red Hat Enterprise Linux與Windows兩種作業系統，企業IT團隊可依不同部署環境的作業需求及法規遵循標準，彈性選擇適合的作業系統，同時維持強固型裝置部署與管理的一致性。Red Hat Enterprise Linux則由客戶自行安裝，方便IT團隊依既有系統配置及安全政策進行部署。
神基指出，軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等產業，對敏感資料保護及資訊安全有較高要求，相關標準也必須延伸至第一線作業環境。Red Hat Enterprise Linux具備多層安全防護機制，包括安全優先的預設配置、最小權限存取控制，以及可於系統建置階段套用的安全設定檔，協助企業符合相關法規及內部安全政策。
此外，Red Hat Enterprise Linux的長期支援週期，也與神基強固型裝置的長期可靠性相互配合，符合軍事國防及關鍵基礎設施產業較長的採購與部署時程，有助延長裝置使用年限，並降低總持有成本(TCO)。
神基控股暨神基科技董事長黃明漢表示，關鍵任務的執行不會止步於網路邊緣，安全防護標準也不應受到限制。對軍事國防、公共安全及公用事業等客戶而言，第一線裝置不應成為資料中心既有IT安全政策的例外，透過Red Hat Enterprise Linux認證，可將既有平台的安全標準從伺服器機房延伸至第一線作業環境，並部署於專為嚴苛環境打造的全強固型硬體裝置。
paras_en: Getac, a subsidiary of Getac Holdings (3005‑TW), announced today that its three fully rugged devices—the UX10, G140 and V120—have passed Red Hat Enterprise Linux hardware certification and are now listed in the Red Hat ecosystem catalog. Customers can install and deploy Red Hat Enterprise Linux themselves according to their operating environment, IT architecture and regulatory compliance needs, offering more OS choices for highly regulated sectors such as defense, public safety and utilities.

Getac said the three certified devices have all received certification for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.2 and subsequent 10.x releases, covering the 10.1‑inch fully rugged tablet UX10, the 14‑inch fully rugged tablet G140 and the 12.2‑inch fully rugged laptop V120.

Because the same hardware platform supports both Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows, enterprise IT teams can flexibly choose the operating system that best fits the deployment scenario and compliance standards while maintaining consistent deployment and management of rugged devices. Red Hat Enterprise Linux is installed by the customer, allowing IT teams to deploy it in line with existing system configurations and security policies.

Getac noted that sectors such as defense, public safety and utilities have heightened requirements for protecting sensitive data and information security, and related standards must extend to frontline operating environments. Red Hat Enterprise Linux provides multi‑layer security mechanisms, including security‑first default settings, least‑privilege access controls, and security configuration files that can be applied during system build, helping enterprises meet relevant regulations and internal security policies.

In addition, the long‑term support lifecycle of Red Hat Enterprise Linux aligns with the long‑term reliability of Getac’s rugged devices, matching the extended procurement and deployment timelines typical of defense and critical infrastructure projects. This synergy helps extend device service life and lower total cost of ownership (TCO).

Chairman Huang Ming‑Han of Getac Holdings and Getac Technology said that executing critical missions does not stop at the network edge, and security standards should not be constrained. For defense, public safety and utility customers, frontline devices should not be exceptions to existing data‑center IT security policies. By achieving Red Hat Enterprise Linux certification, existing platform security standards can be extended from server rooms to frontline environments and deployed on fully rugged hardware built for harsh conditions.
