items.title: 矽谷開始變臉！馬斯克悔捐共和黨4億美元　Palantir執行長自爆「終身民主黨人」
items.title_en: Silicon Valley’s Face‑Changing: Musk Regrets Donating $400 Million to GOP, Palantir CEO Calls Himself a Lifelong Democrat
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國期中選舉落幕後，共和黨「金主」馬斯克開始調整對共和黨的公開姿態，不僅對民主黨籍德州當選州長希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)釋出善意，更坦言後悔為共和黨候選人砸下逾4億美元，笑稱若重來「會少花一點錢」。
馬斯克週三(18日)在《紐約時報》DealBook峰會上直言，選舉投入巨資卻未見相應回報，「這讓我覺得自己相當愚蠢」，但稱若無這筆資金，結果可能更糟。
馬斯克指出，金援目的之一是維持華府權力平衡，不希望白宮、參眾兩院全由同一政黨掌控，他同時也認為，金錢對選舉結果的影響力其實有限。
這番說法與他先前力挺「讓美國再次偉大」(MAGA)陣營的立場明顯區隔。馬斯克強調自己「並非MAGA」，意識形態偏溫和，且不完全認同共和黨政策，認為兩黨皆有優缺點。
對此，美國總統川普週四(19日)受訪時雖稱馬斯克是朋友、「意圖良好」，但也警告偏離MAGA理念者「不會有好結果」。
值得關注的是，馬斯克對民主黨拿下德州州長一役給予正面評價。他身為德州居民，認為希諾霍薩屬溫和派、非極左，預期施政可正常推進，緩解市場對AI與資料中心發展受阻的憂慮。
這股政治風向轉變並非個案。Palantir執行長Alex Karp自稱終身民主黨人，強調公司產品具「進步主義」本質；Meta也重整遊說團隊，由前民主黨幕僚強化華府影響力，同時留任川普政府前官員以維繫白宮管道。
分析人士指出，民主黨掌握國會後將發動科技業聽證調查，矽谷巨頭正重新校準政治投入與政策關係，華府權力板塊移動已讓科技圈開始「兩邊下注」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that after the U.S. midterm elections, Republican benefactor Elon Musk began to adjust his public stance toward the GOP. He not only extended goodwill to Texas Democratic governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa, but also admitted he regrets having poured more than $400 million into Republican candidates, joking that he would have spent a bit less if he could do it over again.

On Wednesday (the 18th), Musk told the New York Times DealBook summit that the huge election spending yielded no commensurate return, saying “it makes me feel pretty stupid,” though he added that the result could have been worse without that money.

Musk said one purpose of the funding was to preserve a balance of power in Washington; he does not want the White House and both chambers of Congress controlled by the same party, and he believes money’s influence on election outcomes is actually limited.

This comment marks a clear break from his earlier support for the “Make America Great Again” (MAGA) camp. Musk stressed he is “not MAGA,” holds a moderate ideology, and does not fully endorse Republican policies, seeing pros and cons on both sides.
In response, President Donald Trump said on Thursday (the 19th) that Musk is a friend with “good intentions,” but warned that anyone straying from the MAGA line “won’t have a good outcome.”

It is notable that Musk praised the Democratic win in the Texas governor’s race. As a Texas resident, he views Hinojosa as a moderate, not a far‑left figure, and expects her administration to proceed smoothly, easing market worries about AI and data‑center development being hampered.

The shift is not isolated. Palantir CEO Alex Karp described himself as a lifelong Democrat and emphasized that the company’s products have a “progressive” nature; Meta has reshuffled its lobbying team, bringing in a former Democratic aide to boost influence in Washington while retaining former Trump‑administration officials to keep White House channels open.

Analysts say that with Democrats controlling Congress they will launch hearings targeting the tech sector, and Silicon Valley giants are recalibrating their political spending and policy relationships, as the power balance in Washington moves and the tech community begins to “bet on both sides.”

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉半導體股領跌 滬指險守3500點大關 連二日收黑
items.title_en: <China Stock Post‑Market> Semiconductor Stocks Lead Decline, Shanghai Index Hovers Around 3500‑Point Threshold, Two Consecutive Days of Losses
paras: 中國A股三大指數周五(20日)齊步走低，上證指數連續第2個交易日收黑，一度跌深至3500點，因AI新創公司Anthropic上市首日表現未能帶領全球科技股止跌。
盤面上，半導體股全日表現低迷，通富微電、金海通盤觸及跌停，阿石創、芯導科技、賽微電子、沫曦股份、盛科通訊跌幅居前；光刻機族群持續下挫，聯合化學、張江高科跌停，久日新材、波長光電、賽微電子跌幅居前；小家電族群重挫，彩虹集團、小熊電器、愛仕達、比依股份觸及跌停，鴻智科技、北鼎股份、利仁科技跌幅居前。
上漲族群方面，電子零件類股​​衝高回落，滿坤科技、駿亞科技、中京電子、東晶電子、澳弘電子、超音波電子觸及漲停，金祿電子、四會富仕、科翔股份漲幅居前；豬肉股表現活躍，金新農漲停，東瑞股份、唐人神、華統股份漲幅居前；銀行股尾盤快速拉升，工商銀行、建設銀行、中信銀行等創新高，平安銀行、交通銀行、農業銀行等逆勢上漲超1%。
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共313檔股票上漲，5234檔下跌，平盤31檔。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共35檔股票漲幅在9%以上，302檔股票跌幅在9%以上。

財信證券表示，市場仍在縮量築底框架內運行，滬指在3550點支撐附近雖有反覆，但未有效失守，但題材波動大、賺錢效應偏弱、情緒低迷。縮量既可為築底，亦可為下跌中繼：若有效跌破3550點且跌停家數繼續放大，則築底框架失效，需防進一步下探;。若放量收復3600點、同時市場賺錢效應有所回暖，可視為情緒修復的初步確認。反攻信號未出現前，維持觀察。方向上，一是半導體製造與材料；二是紅利與消費；三是國產算力鏈。中期來看，海外AI產業鏈不確定性、海外流動性偏緊、硬科技籌碼結構不佳、風險偏好回升仍需時間，增量政策集中出台或外圍風險實質改善將是市場走出調整的關鍵觸發，重點觀察年底中央經濟工作會議前後的市場表現。
萬家基金認為，A股在經歷大幅調整後，後續總體將呈現「寬幅震盪、底部中樞溫和抬升」的格局。 當前市場正處於政策底向基本面底過渡的階段。A股估值已處於歷史偏低分位點，後續搭配穩增長政策托底，具備較厚的安全邊際。後市來看，受制於有效需求修復的斜率及增量資金的觀望情緒，指數向上突破仍需更多宏觀數據的驗證。
國泰基金建議，當前市場仍處於震盪整理階段，成交量持續收縮，反映資金風險偏好尚未全面恢復。考慮到海外政策、AI資本開支回報及市場流動性等不確定性仍在，短期或應以防範波動風險為主，兼顧穩健配置與超跌方向的潛在修復機會，密切關注市場成交及右側企穩信號，避免過度追高。
中原證券認為，當前滬指與創業板指的平均本益比分別為15.77倍、33.52倍，處於近三年中位數平均水平上方，預計滬指繼續震盪整理的可能性較大，結構再平衡為核心特徵，短線建議關注半導體、稀土、電子化學品及航空機場等行業的投資機會。
中信建投證券首席經濟學家黃文濤團隊近日在2027年投資策略報告中提出，「中國向強、經濟向新、市場向上」的核心判斷。在此背景下，A股定價邏輯與流動性結構正被重塑，中國明年股、債、匯均有望走強。配置層面，該團隊建議明年投資者重點增配「人民幣貨幣錨資產」，穩健配置「人民幣流動性資產。
paras_en: China A‑share’s three major indices all fell on Friday (the 20th), with the Shanghai Composite closing in the red for the second consecutive trading day and briefly slipping to the 3,500‑point level, as AI start‑up Anthropic’s debut failed to lift global tech stocks.

The Shanghai Composite fell 1.22% to 3,533.79 points on Friday and is down 2.77% for the week; the Shenzhen Component dropped 3.09% to 10,256.39 points, a cumulative weekly loss of 6.49%; the ChiNext index fell 3.54% to 2,212.13 points, down 8.82% for the week.

On the market, semiconductor stocks were weak all day, with Tongfu Microelectronics and Jinhaitong hitting their daily limits down, while A‑Stone Creation, XinTech, Saimei Electronics, MoXi Co., and Shengke Communications posted the biggest declines; lithography‑machine stocks kept sliding, with United Chemicals and Zhangjiang Hi‑Tech hitting limit‑down, and Jiuri New Materials, Wavelength Optoelectronics and Saimei Electronics among the top losers; small‑appliance stocks crashed, with Rainbow Group, Little Bear Appliances, Aishida and Biyi Co. hitting limit‑down, while Hongzhi Technology, Beiding Co. and Liren Technology fell sharply.

Among the gainers, electronic component stocks surged then retreated, with ManKun Technology, Junya Technology, Zhongjing Electronics, Dongjing Electronics, Ao Hong Electronics and Ultrasonic Electronics hitting limit‑up, while Jinlu Electronics, Si Hui Fu Shi and Kexiang Co. led the rise; pork‑related stocks were active, with Jin Xin Nong hitting limit‑up and Dongrui, Tangrenshen and Huatong posting notable gains; bank stocks rallied sharply in the closing minutes, with ICBC, China Construction Bank and CITIC Bank reaching fresh highs, while Ping An Bank, Bank of Communications and Agricultural Bank rose more than 1% against the trend.

According to Wind data, a total of 313 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges, 5,234 fell and 31 were unchanged. Dazhihui VIP data shows that 35 stocks across the three markets gained more than 9%, while 302 stocks fell more than 9%.

CaiXin Securities said the market is still operating within a low‑volume bottom‑building framework; the Shanghai index has bounced around the 3,550‑point support but has not convincingly broken it, with large thematic swings, weak profit‑making effect and low sentiment. Low volume can signal either bottom‑building or a down‑trend continuation: a decisive break below 3,550 with more limit‑down stocks would invalidate the bottom framework and call for protection against further declines; conversely, a volume‑driven recovery above 3,600 with improving profit‑making sentiment would mark the first sign of emotional repair. Until a clear counter‑attack signal appears, they remain observational. The focus areas are: 1) semiconductor manufacturing and materials; 2) dividends and consumption; 3) domestic computing‑power chain. In the medium term, uncertainties in overseas AI supply chains, tight overseas liquidity, weak hard‑tech capital structures and a slow rebound in risk appetite mean that policy stimulus and tangible improvements in external risks will be key triggers for the market to exit correction, especially around the central economic work conference at year‑end.

WanJia Fund believes that after a sharp correction, A‑shares will likely enter a pattern of “wide‑range oscillation with a gently rising central bottom.” The market is currently transitioning from a policy‑driven bottom to a fundamentals‑driven bottom. A‑share valuations are at historically low levels, and with steady‑growth policies providing support, there is a substantial safety margin. Looking ahead, the pace of effective demand recovery and cautious sentiment among incremental capital will require further macro data to confirm any upward breakout.

Guotai Fund advises that the market remains in a consolidation phase with shrinking trading volume, indicating that risk appetite has not fully recovered. Given ongoing uncertainties around overseas policies, AI capital‑expenditure returns and market liquidity, short‑term focus should be on mitigating volatility risk while balancing stable allocations with potential rebounds in oversold segments, closely monitoring market turnover and right‑side stabilization signals to avoid over‑buying.

Zhongyuan Securities notes that the Shanghai Composite and ChiNext average price‑to‑earnings ratios are currently 15.77 × and 33.52 × respectively, above the three‑year median averages. They expect the Shanghai index to continue oscillating within a consolidation range, with structural rebalancing as the core feature, and suggest short‑term attention to investment opportunities in semiconductors, rare‑earths, electronic chemicals and airport‑related sectors.

CITIC Securities chief economist Huang Wentao’s team, in its 2027 investment strategy report, put forward the core view that “China will be strong, the economy will be new, and the market will rise.” In this context, A‑share pricing logic and liquidity structure are being reshaped, and China’s equities, bonds and currency are all expected to strengthen next year. For allocation, the team recommends increasing exposure to “RMB‑denominated monetary‑anchor assets” and maintaining a stable position in “RMB liquidity assets.”

items.title: 方舟「木頭姐」砸9000萬美元搶進Anthropic 減持輝達因應監管風暴
items.title_en: Ark’s “Wood” Dumps $90 Million to Rush Into Anthropic, Cuts Nvidia Amid Regulatory Storm
paras: 知名投資人「木頭姐」伍德(Cathie Wood)旗下的方舟投資(ARK Invest)，在Anthropic (ANT-US)上市首日，就毫不客氣利用旗下六檔基金，買入了約 93.5 萬股 Anthropic 股票。此外，由於晶片大廠輝達(NVDA-US)在中國市場的曝險部位引發日益嚴格的監管審視，伍德選擇減持輝達股票。
根據最新申報交易記錄，ARK 於 AI 模型開發商 Anthropic 上市首日，透過旗下 6 檔交易所交易基金(ETF)大手筆買入約 93.5 萬股，總投資金額約 7,760 萬至 9,000 萬美元。其中，旗艦基金 ARKK 買入 55.6 萬股為最大大宗。
與此同時，ARK 減持輝達，經由 ARKQ 基金賣出 33,430 股，套現約 500 萬美元。
Anthropic 此次那斯達克IPO發行價為每股 83 美元，成功籌集 813 億美元，打破全球歷史最大 IPO 紀錄。掛牌首日開盤價達 111.50 美元，終場收在 97.17 美元，較發行價上漲約 17%，完全稀釋後的市值高達近 1.8 兆美元。財報顯示，公司截至 9 月底的前九個月營收達 332.4 億美元，較去年同期狂增 1,200%。
相對地，輝達近期面臨嚴峻的監管調查與高層震盪。加州檢察總長邦塔(Rob Bonta)發出調查傳票，對其先進晶片是否違反美國出口限制違法流入中國市場展開調查。此外，前執行長黃仁勳因坦承婚外情而請辭，目前由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)暫代職務。利空籠罩下，輝達股價連續下挫，自 10 月高點回檔約 38%。
市場法人指出，方舟投資本次「買進 Anthropic、削減輝達」的組合操作，反映出在輝達面臨監管陰影與管理過渡期之際，機構資金正加速轉向剛上市且高速成長的 AI 模型領導業者。
paras_en: Renowned investor “Wood” (Cathie Wood) and her firm ARK Invest used six of its funds to buy roughly 935,000 shares of Anthropic (ANT‑US) on the stock’s first trading day, spending about $90 million. At the same time, because chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is facing tighter regulatory scrutiny over its exposure in China, Wood chose to reduce her Nvidia holdings.

According to the latest filing, ARK on Anthropic’s debut day bought about 935,000 shares through six exchange‑traded funds, investing roughly $77.6 million to $90 million. The flagship ARKK fund made the biggest purchase, acquiring 556,000 shares.
Meanwhile, ARK trimmed its Nvidia position, with the ARKQ fund selling 33,430 shares for roughly $5 million in cash.

Anthropic’s Nasdaq IPO was priced at $83 per share, raising $8.13 billion and setting a record as the largest IPO in history. The stock opened at $111.50 on day one and closed at $97.17, about 17% above the offering price, giving a fully diluted market cap of nearly $1.8 trillion. The company reported revenue of $33.24 billion for the nine months ended September, a staggering 1,200% increase year‑over‑year.

Conversely, Nvidia has been hit by a harsh regulatory probe and executive turmoil. California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued a subpoena investigating whether Nvidia’s advanced chips illegally flowed to China in violation of U.S. export rules. Former CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting an extramarital affair, with CFO Colette Kress temporarily assuming the role. Under the cloud of these setbacks, Nvidia’s share price has fallen about 38% from its October peak.

Market analysts note that ARK’s “buy Anthropic, cut Nvidia” strategy reflects a shift of institutional capital toward newly listed, fast‑growing AI model leaders as Nvidia grapters with regulatory shadows and a management transition.

items.title: 阿里巴巴遭股東提起集體訴訟 稱公司隱瞞與Megaspeed密切關係
items.title_en: Alibaba Faces Shareholder Class Action Accusing Company of Concealing Close Ties with Megaspeed
paras: 中國電子商務與雲端服務巨頭阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)及其執行長吳泳銘，於美國時間 11 月 19 日在紐約曼哈頓聯邦法院遭到股東提告團體訴訟。
原告 Withida Bihan 代表自 2024 年 5 月 23 日至 2026 年 11 月 11 日期間持有阿里巴巴美國存託憑證(ADS)的投資者，指控阿里巴巴在 2024、2025 與 2026 財年的年報中，刻意且重大地低估了美國出口管制可能對其業務造成的風險，藉此虛增股價，涉嫌欺詐股東。
這起訴訟的核心焦點在於總部位於新加坡的 Megaspeed 公司。消息指出，Megaspeed 涉嫌協助北京當局取得受限制的輝達(NVDA-US)先進AI晶片。Megaspeed 高層黃樂與輝達前執行長黃仁勳擁有個人關係，而黃仁勳已於前一周辭職。
報導指出，黃樂與其家族建立跨中星兩地的公司網路，繞過管制轉運約 24 萬顆 H100、H200 及部分 A100 晶片進入中國，而阿里巴巴被揭露為 Megaspeed 的「主要客戶」。
媒體曝光阿里巴巴與 Megaspeed 密切關係後，引發市場賣壓。《路透》報導指出，此間諜醜聞可能促使華盛頓當局進一步收緊對中國 AI 企業遠端存取先進處理器的限制，導致阿里巴巴股價在短短4個交易日內劇烈重挫 14%。
針對訴訟指控，阿里巴巴官方尚未立即回應媒體的置評請求。然而，被告之一的阿里巴巴執行長吳泳銘公開表示，儘管黃仁勳離職後美國加碼的算力限制可能影響公司明年的產品與服務，但阿里巴巴仍維持原定目標，計畫在 2030 年前實現 1,000 億美元的外部雲端營收，並達成 20% 的 EBITDA 利潤率。
另一方面，阿里巴巴也在加州聯邦法院對美國國防部將其列入「中國軍方企業」名單提出訴訟，並於上月獲得法官頒布禁制令。
paras_en: China's e‑commerce and cloud services giant Alibaba (BABA‑US) (09988‑HK) and its chief executive Daniel Zhang (Wu Yongming) were sued by shareholders in a class action filed in the U.S. Manhattan Federal Court on November 19.

Plaintiff Withida Bihan, representing investors who held Alibaba American Depositary Shares (ADS) from May 23, 2024, through November 11, 2026, alleges that Alibaba deliberately and materially understated the risk that U.S. export controls could pose to its business in its 2024, 2025 and 2026 annual reports, thereby inflating the stock price and committing fraud against shareholders.

The core of the lawsuit centers on Singapore‑based Megaspeed. Reports say Megaspeed is accused of helping Beijing obtain restricted Nvidia (NVDA‑US) advanced AI chips. Megaspeed executive Huang Le has a personal relationship with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned the previous week.

According to the filing, Huang Le and his family built a cross‑border corporate network spanning China and Singapore that bypassed controls to ship roughly 240,000 H100, H200 and some A100 chips into China, with Alibaba identified as Megaspeed’s “primary customer.”

Media exposure of Alibaba’s close ties to Megaspeed sparked selling pressure in the market. Reuters reported that the espionage scandal could prompt Washington to tighten restrictions on Chinese AI firms’ remote access to advanced processors, causing Alibaba’s share price to plunge 14% over just four trading days.

Alibaba has not yet responded to media requests for comment on the lawsuit. However, one of the defendants, CEO Daniel Zhang, publicly said that although Jensen Huang’s departure and the U.S. tightening of compute‑capacity limits may affect the company’s products and services next year, Alibaba remains on track with its goal to achieve $100 billion in external cloud revenue by 2030 and a 20% EBITDA margin.

Separately, Alibaba has filed a lawsuit in a California federal court challenging the U.S. Department of Defense’s designation of the company as a “Chinese military enterprise,” and last month a judge issued an injunction in its favor.

items.title: 不甩升息預期！美債連漲5天將創今年最長紀錄  誰在逆勢買？
items.title_en: No Relief for Rate Hike Expectations! U.S. Treasuries Rise for Five Consecutive Days, Set to Break This Year's Longest Streak – Who Is Buying Against the Trend?
paras: 當聯準會(Fed)還在盤算下一輪升息，美債市場卻逆勢走出連5漲行情，各天期美債殖利率週五(20日)普遍下跌2至3個基點，追蹤美債回報的指數追平今年6月29日以來的最長漲勢紀錄。
這輪反彈的推手，是華爾街對AI熱潮的動搖。投資人開始重估科技股的高估值與巨額資本開支，焦慮情緒向大盤擴散，拖累全球股市邁向逾三年來的最長跌勢。資金加速湧入債市避險，同時推升美元，美元指數則有望出現週線連四紅情形。
長端美債明顯跑贏短端。高盛董事總經理Richard Privorotsky分析指出，資本開支預期下調與大宗商品價格回落，正促使市場將經濟成長放緩計入資產價格，走勢與2018年末頗為相似。Privorotsky認為，相當一部分緊縮預期已被提前消化，但不代表Fed政策方向已轉向。
根據Fed週三(18日)公布的會議紀錄，決策官員以10比2維持利率於3.75%至4%，但自今年9月完成三年來首次升息後，幾乎所有官員仍認為需要繼續升息，兩名官員更提出12月升息幅度可能超過25個基點。
在雙重壓制下，美債10年期殖利率仍守在5%上方，正逼近近20年來停留在5%以上最長天數紀錄。分析師認為，AI交易尚未全面失守，推動美債殖利率大幅跌破5%基本面的依據仍舊薄弱。
paras_en: While the Federal Reserve is still weighing its next rate hike, the U.S. Treasury market has moved counter‑to‑trend with five straight days of gains. On Friday the 20th, yields across the curve fell 2–3 basis points, and the Treasury‑return index tied the longest winning streak since June 29 this year.

The driver of this rebound is Wall Street’s wobble over the AI hype. Investors are re‑evaluating the lofty valuations and massive cap‑ex of tech stocks, spreading anxiety to the broader market and dragging global equities into their longest decline in over three years. Money is rushing into bonds for safety, which also lifts the dollar, and the dollar index is poised for a fourth consecutive weekly gain.

Long‑dated Treasuries are clearly outperforming short‑dated ones. Goldman Sachs managing director Richard Privorotsky notes that lower cap‑ex forecasts and falling commodity prices are prompting the market to price in slower economic growth, a pattern reminiscent of late 2018. Privorotsky believes a sizable portion of tightening expectations has already been priced in, but that does not mean the Fed’s policy stance has shifted.

According to the Fed’s minutes released on Wednesday the 18th, policymakers voted 10‑2 to keep the policy rate at 3.75%‑4.0%. However, since the first rate hike in three years in September, almost all officials still see a need for further hikes, with two members even suggesting a December increase could exceed 25 basis points.

Under this double pressure, the 10‑year Treasury yield remains above 5%, approaching the longest stretch in nearly two decades with yields staying above the 5% mark. Analysts say AI‑driven trading has not yet fully collapsed, and the fundamental case for a sharp drop of Treasury yields below 5% remains weak.

items.title: 輝達股價恐暴跌至100美元？機構提出看空的主要理由
items.title_en: Nvidia Stock Could Plunge to $100? Institutions Cite Main Bearish Reasons
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 股票近期遭遇劇烈修正，週四收盤下跌 3.3% 至約 147 美元。自今年 10 月創下約 240 美元的歷史新高以來，股價已累積修正達 38%，2026 年開年至今則下跌 21%，市值在短短六個交易日內蒸發近 6,690 億美元。
儘管公司最新公布的第三季營收高達 1,158 億美元，年增幅度達 103%，且資料中心業務營收大幅成長 110% 至 1,076 億美元，但高層人事變動與市場對 AI 基礎設施投資永續性的疑慮，持續壓抑股價表現。

看空觀點：技術面破裂與流動性退潮

針對輝達後市，Sungarden Investment 創辦人Rob Isbitts 發文警告，輝達股價在未來 12 至 18 個月內恐下探至 100 美元，相較於近期股價意味著約 32% 的額外下行空間。
Isbitts 表示，此預測並非單純基於前執行長黃仁勳離職的爭議，而是源於技術指標破裂與整體市場流動性惡化。
Isbitts 分析指出，被動式指數基金在市場平倉時將形成自動拋售壓力。他強調：「在流動性驅動的平倉潮中，將領總是最後被清算，而他們的跌幅也最為猛烈。」
他補充說明，輝達在指數基金中的高權重，可能使其在資本抽離時首當其衝。此外，Isbitts 提出對 AI 產業生態系中「循環融資」(circular financing)的疑慮，即資金在大廠、開發商與晶片製造商之間重覆流轉，一旦資本流動減緩，將為輝達帶來重大風險。

觀望財務透明度與公司回應

TipRanks 頂尖投資人James Foord 則將輝達股票評級調降至「持有」。Foord 表示，雖然輝達長期獲利能力依然強勁，但公司目前高達 1,180 億美元的財務擔保與 3,900 億美元的購買承諾，在客戶需求放緩時可能產生極高風險。此外，應收帳款增加與監管調查等未確定因素，讓投資人抱持觀望態度。
同時，加州檢察總長Rob Bonta 已針對輝達發出調查傳票，要求公司釐清其晶片出口與財務揭露問題；Cathie Wood 旗下的方舟投資(ARK Invest)近期也連續拋售輝達股票。
面對市場焦慮，輝達代執行長克雷斯(Colette Kress) 在法說會上試圖穩定投資人信心。克雷斯強調，輝達擁有多年期技術發展藍圖，目前與客戶及供應鏈的合作「一切維持正常」，董事會正積極尋求常任執行長人選。
目前華爾街機構對輝達整體仍維持「溫和買進」(Moderate Buy)的共識評級。在過去三個月發布的報告中，包含 30 項「買進」、13 項「持有」與 1 項「賣出」，平均 12 個月目標價為 232.59 美元。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares have recently undergone a sharp correction, closing Thursday down 3.3% at about $147. Since hitting an all‑time high of roughly $240 in October, the stock has fallen 38% overall and is down 21% since the start of 2026, wiping out nearly $669 billion in market value over just six trading days.

Despite reporting third‑quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year, and data‑center revenue soaring 110% to $107.6 billion, executive turnover and lingering doubts about the sustainability of AI‑infrastructure spending continue to weigh on the share price.

Bearish view: technical breakdown and liquidity retreat. Sungarden Investment founder Rob Isbitts warned that Nvidia’s price could dip to $100 within the next 12‑18 months, representing roughly 32% additional downside from current levels.

Isbitts said the forecast is not merely based on the controversy surrounding former CEO Jensen Huang’s departure, but stems from broken technical indicators and a broader deterioration in market liquidity.

He noted that passive index funds will generate automatic selling pressure when they unwind positions, stressing, “In a liquidity‑driven unwind, the leaders are always the last to be liquidated, and their declines are the steepest.”

He added that Nvidia’s large weighting in index funds could make it the first hit when capital pulls out. Isbitts also raised concerns about “circular financing” in the AI ecosystem, where money circulates repeatedly among big firms, developers and chip makers, creating a material risk for Nvidia if capital flows slow.

Watchful on financial transparency and corporate response. TipRanks top investor James Foord downgraded Nvidia to a “Hold.” Foord said that while Nvidia’s long‑term profitability remains strong, its $118 billion of financial guarantees and $390 billion of purchase commitments could pose extreme risk if customer demand eases, and rising receivables and regulatory investigations add uncertainty for investors.

Meanwhile, California Attorney General Rob Bonta has issued a subpoena to Nvidia demanding clarification on chip export and financial disclosure issues; Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest has also been steadily selling Nvidia shares recently.

Facing market anxiety, interim CEO Colette Kress tried to steady investor confidence at the earnings call, emphasizing that Nvidia has a multi‑year technology roadmap, that collaborations with customers and the supply chain are “all normal,” and that the board is actively seeking a permanent CEO.

Wall Street institutions still maintain a “Moderate Buy” consensus on Nvidia. In reports issued over the past three months, there were 30 “Buy,” 13 “Hold,” and 1 “Sell” recommendations, with an average 12‑month target price of $232.59.

items.title: ESCO併購Megger擴大電網檢測版圖電力公司是主力客戶
items.title_en: ESCO Acquires Megger to Expand Power Grid Testing Footprint, Power Utilities Are Core Customers
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國工業測試設備商ESCO Technologies(ESE-US)完成收購電網檢測業者Megger，預估2027財年營收達20.5億至20.9億美元，年增55%至58%。併購擴大ESCO在電網檢測市場的規模，主要客戶是電力公司。ESCO管理層估計，與資料中心建設直接相關的銷售，僅占旗下Doble與Megger合計營收的1%至2%。
電力公司擴建輸配電網，新設備啟用前需要測試，既有設備也得定期檢查，避免故障停電。這類需求在併購前已反映在訂單上。Doble在2026財年接單年增19%，其中第四季成長11%至1.13億美元。ESCO表示，電網維護與擴建是帶動接單成長的主因。
ESCO於10月1日完成交割，預估Megger在2027財年將貢獻6.4億至6.6億美元營收，約占集團預估營收三成。不計Megger，集團營收預估年增7%至9%，顯示新財年營收大幅成長主要來自併購。
ESCO已將整合後可節省的2,000萬美元成本納入2027財年財測，尚未計入雙方透過彼此通路銷售產品可能增加的營收。後續整合能否帶來新訂單，將是衡量併購效益的另一項指標。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. industrial testing equipment maker ESCO Technologies (ESE‑US) completed its acquisition of power‑grid testing firm Megger, projecting FY2027 revenue of $2.05 billion to $2.09 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 55% to 58%. The deal expands ESCO’s scale in the power‑grid testing market, whose main customers are electric utilities. ESCO’s management estimates that sales directly tied to data‑center construction will account for only 1% to 2% of the combined revenue of its Doble and Megger businesses.

Power utilities are expanding transmission and distribution networks, and new equipment must be tested before commissioning while existing assets require periodic inspections to prevent outages. This demand was already reflected in orders before the acquisition. Doble’s FY2026 order intake grew 19% year‑over‑year, with Q4 up 11% to $113 million. ESCO said that grid maintenance and expansion are the primary drivers of order growth.

ESCO completed the transaction on October 1, and expects Megger to contribute $640 million to $660 million in FY2027 revenue, roughly 30% of the group’s projected revenue. Excluding Megger, the group’s revenue is forecast to grow 7% to 9% year‑over‑year, indicating that the bulk of the new‑year revenue expansion comes from the acquisition.

ESCO has already factored the $20 million cost savings from the integration into its FY2027 financial outlook, but has not yet accounted for any incremental revenue that could arise from cross‑selling products through each other’s channels. Whether the integration will generate new orders will be another metric for assessing the deal’s success.

items.title: Anthropic史上最大IPO「悲喜參半」！後市看機構買盤與解禁考驗
items.title_en: Anthropic's Largest IPO Ever Is a Mixed Bag; Future Will Test Institutional Buying and Share Unlocks
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 新創 Anthropic (ANT-US) 週四 (19 日) 完成史上最大首次公開發行 (IPO)，上市首日收漲 17.07%，卻未能如部分投資人期待，帶動科技股全面反彈。分析師指出，這場上市案為公司補足發展 AI 所需的龐大資金，但真正的考驗仍在未來幾週至幾個月，機構投資人是否進場，以及員工與內部人士持股陸續解禁後的承接力道，將決定後續走勢。
Anthropic 此次以高於原先預期的價格發行，並擴大出售股數，募資規模超越 SpaceX (SPCX-US)，改寫全球 IPO 紀錄。
股價首日收報 97.17 美元，較每股 83 美元的發行價上漲 17.07%，以未稀釋股本計算，收盤市值約 1.28 兆美元。
《MarketWatch》報導，Water Tower Research 分析師 James Kisner 表示，有些人可能認為，相較其他科技公司 IPO，Anthropic 首日表現不夠亮眼，但上市後漲幅越大是否越好，仍有討論空間，因為大幅飆漲也可能意味著公司發行價訂得太低，未能取得原本可募集的資金。
不過，他形容此次 IPO 的執行結果「悲喜參半」，因為 Anthropic 能帶動整體市場上揚的期待，並未實現。
Anthropic 掛牌時，市場正面臨高通膨、輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長接班問題，以及出口政策不確定性等多重壓力。
Mission Wealth 投資長 Kieran Osborne 指出，部分投資人可能為了買進 Anthropic，減碼其他科技股持倉。
美股週四全面收黑，道瓊工業指數下跌 2.19%，標普 500 指數收低 2.02%，那斯達克綜合指數收黑 2.25%，羅素 2000 指數下滑 2.18%。四大指數均朝創下自 2025 年 4 月 4 日當週以來最差單週表現邁進。
儘管未能帶動大盤，D.A. Davidson 科技研究主管 Gil Luria 認為，Anthropic 上市仍是 AI 產業的「重要里程碑」。
根據此次 IPO 細節與公司最新財務報表，相關交易完成後，Anthropic 將持有超過 2,300 億美元現金。
Luria 表示：「Anthropic 現在擁有龐大的資金準備，可以向供應商購買更多運算資源，主要供應商包括亞馬遜、Google 與 SpaceX。這些公司也因此能更明確掌握需求，進而向博通、輝達與美光購買更多晶片。」
這筆資金能否轉化為持續的運算支出與供應鏈訂單，將是市場觀察 AI 投資熱潮能否延續的重要線索。

Renaissance Capital 分析師 Nick Smith 則認為，Anthropic「相當強勁的上市首日表現」，也為後續 IPO 釋出正面訊號。他指出，包括 Nscale 在內的數家公司，可能已準備在感恩節後啟動上市。Nscale 與 Anthropic 簽有一項價值 446 億美元的 AI 運算服務協議；Anthropic 的主要競爭對手 OpenAI，也正考慮最快於 2027 年上市。
不過，Smith 補充：「我們仍要觀察 Anthropic 接下來的股價走勢，以及這可能帶來什麼影響。」
散戶是此次上市的重要買盤。
根據 Vanda Research，Anthropic 掛牌首日的散戶 IPO 參與程度，創下至少自 2012 年有紀錄以來最高。
Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) 執行長也表示，平台客戶對 Anthropic 股票的需求，「遠高於」實際獲配額度。
相較之下，Baird 董事總經理 Ted Mortonson 指出，機構投資人通常採取較長期的布局策略，等待新上市股票出現更具吸引力的價格後才進場。因此，機構未來幾週的投資決策，將對 Anthropic 股價產生重要影響。
此外，Anthropic 預料將陸續納入主要股票指數，可能包括那斯達克 100 指數，帶來追蹤相關指數的資金配置需求；但另一方面，內部人士持股的初期閉鎖限制也將陸續解除。
週四已有數億股股票開放交易，下個月還將有另外 1.74 億股 A 類股票解禁，增加市場可交易的股票供給。
Powerlaw 投資長 Ben Black 表示：「在這些股票解禁之前，我們還無法知道市場需求究竟有多大。」
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic (ANT-US) completed the largest initial public offering in history on Thursday (the 19th), closing its first day up 17.07%, but it failed to spark a broad rally in tech stocks as some investors had hoped. Analysts say the IPO provides the massive capital needed for AI development, yet the real test will come in the coming weeks to months, depending on whether institutional investors step in and how well employee and insider holdings hold up after lock‑up periods expire, which will shape the stock’s trajectory.
Anthropic priced the offering above its original expectations and increased the number of shares sold, raising more capital than SpaceX (SPCX-US) and rewriting the global IPO record.
The shares closed at $97.17 on the first day, up 17.07% from the $83 issue price, giving an undiluted market value of roughly $1.28 trillion at the close.

MarketWatch reported that Water Tower Research analyst James Kisner said some may view Anthropic’s first‑day performance as underwhelming compared with other tech IPOs, but a larger post‑IPO jump is not necessarily better, as a steep rise could indicate the issue price was set too low and the company missed out on potential funds.
He described the IPO’s execution as “bittersweet,” because Anthropic generated expectations of a broader market lift that did not materialize.
When Anthropic listed, the market was dealing with high inflation, a succession issue at Nvidia (NVDA-US), and uncertainty over export policies, among other pressures.
Mission Wealth’s chief investment officer Kieran Osborne noted that some investors might be trimming other tech positions to buy Anthropic.

U.S. equities closed lower across the board on Thursday, with the Dow down 2.19%, the S&P 500 down 2.02%, the Nasdaq Composite down 2.25% and the Russell 2000 down 2.18%, each heading toward their worst weekly performance since the week of April 4, 2025.
Although it did not lift the broader market, D.A. Davidson technology research head Gil Luria said Anthropic’s listing remains an “important milestone” for the AI industry.
Based on the IPO details and the company’s latest financial statements, Anthropic will hold more than $230 billion in cash after the transaction completes.

Luria added, “Anthropic now has a massive cash reserve it can use to buy more compute capacity from suppliers, mainly Amazon, Google and SpaceX. Those companies can then better gauge demand and purchase more chips from Broadcom, Nvidia and Micron.”
Whether this cash translates into sustained compute spending and supply‑chain orders will be a key indicator of whether the AI investment boom can continue.

Renaissance Capital analyst Nick Smith said Anthropic’s “very strong first‑day performance” sends a positive signal for future IPOs. He noted that several companies, including Nscale, appear ready to go public after Thanksgiving; Nscale has a $44.6 billion AI compute services agreement with Anthropic, and OpenAI, Anthropic’s main rival, is also considering an IPO as early as 2027.
Smith added, “We still need to watch Anthropic’s price action going forward and see what impact it may have.”
Retail investors were a major source of buying in this IPO.
According to Vanda Research, retail participation in Anthropic’s debut day was the highest on record since at least 2012.
Robinhood Markets (HOOD-US) CEO said platform users’ demand for Anthropic stock was “far higher” than the actual allocation they received.

In contrast, Baird’s managing director Ted Mortonson pointed out that institutional investors typically take a longer‑term approach, waiting for newly listed stocks to reach more attractive price levels before entering. Thus, institutional decisions in the coming weeks will significantly affect Anthropic’s share price.
Anthropic expects to be added to major indices, possibly including the Nasdaq‑100, which would draw index‑tracking capital, while insider lock‑up restrictions will gradually lift.
Hundreds of millions of shares began trading on Thursday, and another 174 million Class A shares are slated to unlock next month, increasing the pool of tradable stock.
Powerlaw chief investment officer Ben Black said, “We won’t know how strong market demand is until these shares unlock.”

items.title: 中國交出2026 APEC東道主成績單！75項成果與互聯互通藍圖勾勒亞太共同體路線圖
items.title_en: China Delivers 2026 APEC Host Report Card: 75 Achievements and an Interconnectivity Blueprint Outline the Asia‑Pacific Community Roadmap
paras: 今年中國擔任亞太經合會(APEC)東道主，周四(19日)正式對外發布成果清單，共計75項，涵蓋會議成果文件、重大倡議與務實合作三大層級；其中備受矚目的《APEC互聯互通藍圖》同步出爐，以「硬聯通、軟聯通、心聯通」三支柱為框架，把亞太共同體建設從願景推向可執行的年度清單。
根據中國外交部網站公布的內容，75項成果分為三塊：18項會議成果文件、3項中方推進亞太共同體建設重大舉措、54項務實合作成果。

APEC領袖層級通過《APEC領導人關於建設亞太共同體的深圳展望》、《APEC貿易數字化合作框架（2027—2030）》、《APEC互聯互通藍圖》及《關於亞太地區新興技術促進就業和繁榮的聲明》四份核心文件；部長級會議則涵蓋外交貿易、數字與AI、能源、糧食安全、中小企業、財政、運輸、人力資源等13份聯合聲明或主席聲明，其中包括在成都發布的數位和AI部長會議聲明、在蘇州發布的貿易部長會議聯合聲明、在南京發布的人力資源開發部長聲明。
中國同時端出三項旗艦舉措：成立亞太共同體研究中心(深圳)、倡議成立世界灣區經濟合作聯盟、提供2000萬美元資助開展APEC務實合作，被視為把智庫、平台與資金三者綁定的長期布局。
54項務實合作則按經貿、聯通、創新、發展四大方面展開。經貿方面，會上發布《關於亞太自貿區的聲明》、啟動APEC無紙貿易卓越中心、推出數位貿易政策對話與AI創新倡議。
聯通方面則有宣布延長APEC商務旅行卡停留期、擴員亞太示範電子口岸網絡、發布《APEC互聯互通藍圖（2015-2025）》終期審議報告。
創新方面則有設立「AI+能源」專項任務組、中國-APEC數位技術賦能中心、數據跨境流動合作中國中心。
發展方面則涵蓋健康老化行動計劃、零碳城市合作框架、清潔能源培訓學院、中小企業合作區與青年財經人才交流等。

作為本輪成果的骨架，《互聯互通藍圖》給出三條施力路徑。「硬聯通」聚焦陸海空與多式聯運、能源基建互聯、下一代通訊與低軌衛星、農村數位覆蓋，並強調把韌性減災與全週期成本納入項目規劃；「軟聯通」則指向海關現代化、邊境後壁壘拆除、供應鏈堵點破解、跨境隱私規則對接與資本市場互聯；「心聯通」則落在商務旅行卡與虛擬商旅卡、終身學習與技能再培訓、中小微企業正規化、文化旅遊便利化。藍圖明確2027至2030年將於每年一次高官會跟蹤落實情況。
從產業視角看，這份清單最值得關注的不是項目數量，而是AI、能源、數據、中小企業四條線被同時寫進規則層。AI與能源雙向賦能政策推薦、數位智能標準賦能綠色低碳倡議、分布式數據驗證平台倡議等，意味著中方試圖把新興技術議題從「展示」推進到「標準與平台」階段；而商旅卡延期、無紙貿易中心、電子口岸擴員，則是把交通便利化直接轉化為企業可感知的成本下降。
不過，75項成果的含金量最終取決於落實速度。多數文件屬非約束性倡議，2027年起的高官會年度審議將是第一個真實對帳點，亞太共同體則是停在公報裡，還是走進企業的報關單、簽證頁與電網調度室，未來兩年將見分曉。
paras_en: This year China served as host of the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) and on Thursday (the 19th) officially released a list of achievements, totaling 75 items covering three tiers: meeting outcome documents, major initiatives, and practical cooperation. Among them, the highly‑anticipated "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint" was unveiled, structured around three pillars—hard connectivity, soft connectivity, and heart‑to‑heart connectivity—shifting the Asia‑Pacific community building from vision to an actionable annual agenda.

According to content posted on the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs website, the 75 outcomes are divided into three sections: 18 meeting outcome documents, three major initiatives by China to advance the Asia‑Pacific community, and 54 practical cooperation results.

At the leaders’ level, APEC adopted four core documents: the "APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook on Building an Asia‑Pacific Community," the "APEC Trade Digitalization Cooperation Framework (2027‑2030)," the "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint," and the "Statement on Emerging Technologies Promoting Employment and Prosperity in the Asia‑Pacific Region." Ministerial meetings produced 13 joint or chair statements covering foreign trade, digital and AI, energy, food security, SMEs, finance, transport, and human resources, including the digital and AI ministers’ statement released in Chengdu, the trade ministers’ joint statement released in Suzhou, and the human‑resource development ministers’ statement released in Nanjing.

China also put forward three flagship initiatives: establishing an Asia‑Pacific Community Research Center in Shenzhen, proposing the creation of a World Bay Area Economic Cooperation Alliance, and providing US$20 million to fund APEC practical cooperation, a long‑term strategy linking think‑tank expertise, platform building, and financing.

The 54 practical cooperation items are organized into four themes: trade and economics, connectivity, innovation, and development. In the trade and economics area, the summit issued a "Statement on the Asia‑Pacific Free Trade Area," launched an APEC Paper‑less Trade Excellence Center, and introduced a digital trade policy dialogue and AI innovation initiative.

In the connectivity domain, the summit announced an extension of the APEC Business Travel Card validity, expanded the Asia‑Pacific Demonstration Electronic Port Network, and released the final review report of the "APEC Interconnectivity Blueprint (2015‑2025)."
On innovation, the summit established a dedicated "AI + Energy" task force, a China‑APEC Digital Technology Enablement Center, and a China Center for Cross‑Border Data Flow Cooperation.

The development pillar includes a Healthy Aging Action Plan, a Zero‑Carbon City Cooperation Framework, a Clean Energy Training Institute, SME cooperation zones, and youth finance talent exchange programs.

The "Interconnectivity Blueprint"—the backbone of this round of outcomes—outlines three implementation pathways. "Hard connectivity" focuses on land, sea, air and multimodal transport, energy‑infrastructure links, next‑generation communications and low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, and rural digital coverage, emphasizing resilience, disaster mitigation, and life‑cycle cost in project planning. "Soft connectivity" targets customs modernization, removal of border frictions, resolution of supply‑chain bottlenecks, alignment of cross‑border privacy rules, and capital‑market integration. "Heart‑to‑heart connectivity" covers business travel cards and virtual travel cards, lifelong learning and skills retraining, formalization of micro‑, small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises, and facilitation of cultural tourism. The blueprint specifies that from 2027 to 2030, senior‑official meetings will annually track implementation.

From an industry perspective, the most noteworthy aspect of the list is not the sheer number of projects but the inclusion of AI, energy, data, and SMEs across the regulatory layer. Policies that mutually empower AI and energy, digital‑intelligent standards that enable green low‑carbon initiatives, and proposals for distributed data verification platforms indicate China’s intent to move emerging‑technology topics from showcase to standards and platform stages. Meanwhile, extensions of business travel cards, the paper‑less trade center, and expansion of electronic ports translate improved mobility directly into tangible cost reductions for enterprises.

However, the ultimate value of the 75 outcomes depends on implementation speed. Most documents are non‑binding initiatives, and the annual senior‑official review starting in 2027 will be the first real accountability checkpoint. Whether the Asia‑Pacific community remains a statement in a communiqué or becomes embedded in customs declarations, visa pages, and power‑grid dispatch rooms will become clear over the next two years.

items.title: 矽谷開始變臉！馬斯克悔捐共和黨4億美元　Palantir執行長自爆「終身民主黨人」
items.title_en: Silicon Valley’s Face‑Changing: Musk Regrets Donating $400 Million to GOP, Palantir CEO Calls Himself a Lifelong Democrat
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國期中選舉落幕後，共和黨「金主」馬斯克開始調整對共和黨的公開姿態，不僅對民主黨籍德州當選州長希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)釋出善意，更坦言後悔為共和黨候選人砸下逾4億美元，笑稱若重來「會少花一點錢」。
馬斯克週三(18日)在《紐約時報》DealBook峰會上直言，選舉投入巨資卻未見相應回報，「這讓我覺得自己相當愚蠢」，但稱若無這筆資金，結果可能更糟。
馬斯克指出，金援目的之一是維持華府權力平衡，不希望白宮、參眾兩院全由同一政黨掌控，他同時也認為，金錢對選舉結果的影響力其實有限。
這番說法與他先前力挺「讓美國再次偉大」(MAGA)陣營的立場明顯區隔。馬斯克強調自己「並非MAGA」，意識形態偏溫和，且不完全認同共和黨政策，認為兩黨皆有優缺點。
對此，美國總統川普週四(19日)受訪時雖稱馬斯克是朋友、「意圖良好」，但也警告偏離MAGA理念者「不會有好結果」。
值得關注的是，馬斯克對民主黨拿下德州州長一役給予正面評價。他身為德州居民，認為希諾霍薩屬溫和派、非極左，預期施政可正常推進，緩解市場對AI與資料中心發展受阻的憂慮。
這股政治風向轉變並非個案。Palantir執行長Alex Karp自稱終身民主黨人，強調公司產品具「進步主義」本質；Meta也重整遊說團隊，由前民主黨幕僚強化華府影響力，同時留任川普政府前官員以維繫白宮管道。
分析人士指出，民主黨掌握國會後將發動科技業聽證調查，矽谷巨頭正重新校準政治投入與政策關係，華府權力板塊移動已讓科技圈開始「兩邊下注」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that after the U.S. midterm elections, Republican benefactor Elon Musk began to adjust his public stance toward the GOP. He not only extended goodwill to Texas Democratic governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa, but also admitted he regrets having poured more than $400 million into Republican candidates, joking that he would have spent a bit less if he could do it over again.

On Wednesday (the 18th), Musk told the New York Times DealBook summit that the huge election spending yielded no commensurate return, saying “it makes me feel pretty stupid,” though he added that the result could have been worse without that money.

Musk said one purpose of the funding was to preserve a balance of power in Washington; he does not want the White House and both chambers of Congress controlled by the same party, and he believes money’s influence on election outcomes is actually limited.

This comment marks a clear break from his earlier support for the “Make America Great Again” (MAGA) camp. Musk stressed he is “not MAGA,” holds a moderate ideology, and does not fully endorse Republican policies, seeing pros and cons on both sides.
In response, President Donald Trump said on Thursday (the 19th) that Musk is a friend with “good intentions,” but warned that anyone straying from the MAGA line “won’t have a good outcome.”

It is notable that Musk praised the Democratic win in the Texas governor’s race. As a Texas resident, he views Hinojosa as a moderate, not a far‑left figure, and expects her administration to proceed smoothly, easing market worries about AI and data‑center development being hampered.

The shift is not isolated. Palantir CEO Alex Karp described himself as a lifelong Democrat and emphasized that the company’s products have a “progressive” nature; Meta has reshuffled its lobbying team, bringing in a former Democratic aide to boost influence in Washington while retaining former Trump‑administration officials to keep White House channels open.

Analysts say that with Democrats controlling Congress they will launch hearings targeting the tech sector, and Silicon Valley giants are recalibrating their political spending and policy relationships, as the power balance in Washington moves and the tech community begins to “bet on both sides.”

items.title: 美國晶片管制衝擊中國雲端阿里雲成長恐放緩、騰訊新模型開發受阻
items.title_en: US Chip Restrictions Hit China's Cloud: Alibaba Cloud Growth May Slow, Tencent New Model Development Hindered
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國收緊中國企業透過海外資料中心取得先進AI算力的條件，阿里巴巴與騰訊都預期會受到影響，但衝擊不在同一處。阿里巴巴預估，2027年雲端營收增幅可能降至30%至45%；騰訊則認為，現有雲端業務不致受到重大影響，短期壓力主要落在下一代AI模型的開發。
阿里巴巴截至9月底的一季，AI雲端及運算服務營收年增53%，達人民幣609.7億元。公司表示，新規可能影響明年的產品與服務，也可能迫使公司調低原定20GW的算力建設目標。阿里巴巴仍維持2030年對外雲端營收達1,000億美元的目標，接下來將更仰賴自研晶片與中國本土算力支撐成長。
騰訊的情況不同。公司指出，帶動雲端營收的主要是AI推論，也就是讓已訓練好的模型回答問題或執行任務。這類工作已有中國國產晶片可用，因此騰訊預期現有雲端服務受到的影響較小。但訓練下一代模型需要更強的算力，先進晶片取得受限，短期內可能拖慢開發。
兩家的差異在於，國產晶片已能支撐部分線上服務，但能否及時補上大型模型訓練與雲端擴容所需的算力，仍取決於供應規模。阿里巴巴接下來要看本土算力能否跟上雲端業務的擴張，騰訊則要看下一代模型的開發時程會延後多久。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The United States is tightening the conditions under which Chinese companies can obtain advanced AI compute power through overseas data centers. Alibaba and Tencent both expect to be affected, but the impact will be different. Alibaba estimates that its cloud revenue growth could fall to 30%‑45% in 2027, while Tencent believes its existing cloud business will not suffer a major hit; the short‑term pressure will mainly be on the development of next‑generation AI models.

Alibaba reported that in the quarter ending September, AI cloud and computing services revenue grew 53% year‑on‑year to RMB 60.97 billion. The company said the new regulations could affect next year’s products and services and might force it to lower its original 20 GW compute capacity target. Alibaba still maintains its goal of reaching $100 billion in external cloud revenue by 2030 and will rely more on its own chips and domestic compute resources to sustain growth.

Tencent’s situation is different. The company noted that the main driver of its cloud revenue is AI inference – using already‑trained models to answer questions or perform tasks. Such workloads can already be handled by domestically produced Chinese chips, so Tencent expects only a limited impact on its current cloud services. However, training next‑generation models requires much stronger compute power, and limited access to advanced chips could slow development in the short term.

The contrast between the two firms is that domestic chips can now support some online services, but whether they can promptly fill the compute gap needed for large‑scale model training and cloud expansion depends on supply scale. Alibaba will have to see if local compute capacity can keep pace with its cloud business expansion, while Tencent will have to watch how much the timeline for next‑generation model development is delayed.

items.title: 日本南鳥島深海稀土試採明年2月擴大2028年3月前評估能否商轉
items.title_en: Japan to Expand Deep-Sea Rare Earth Test at Minami-Tori Shima in February 2027, Assess Commercial Viability by March 2028
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本將於2027年2月2日在南鳥島外海啟動新一輪深海稀土泥採礦試驗。日本內閣府計畫負責人石井正一11月20日表示，整體試驗預計為期50天，後續將評估技術可行性與成本，並在2028年3月前彙整結果。這次試驗要回答的是，能把稀土泥抽上船之後，能不能穩定地採掘、運輸，再提煉成可用的原料。
日本海洋研究開發機構今年2月已從南鳥島外海近6,000公尺深的海底抽取稀土泥，三天共回收約50公噸，不含作業時加入的海水。分析顯示，樣本所含稀土元素中，約54%是釔、釓、鏑等中重稀土。這是稀土元素的組成比例，不是整批泥的稀土含量。
下一輪試驗將把抽取的泥漿運到南鳥島脫水，再送往日本本土測試分離、精煉與冶煉。前一輪主要驗證設備能否在深海抽泥；這一輪則要把海上作業、運輸及陸上處理接起來，才能估算從採掘到成品的成本。
日本推動這項計畫，是為了增加稀土來源、降低對中國供應的依賴。石井表示，目前仍處於研究與試驗階段。能否成為穩定供應來源，取決於整套流程能否放大，以及放大後的成本是否可負擔。

paras_en: On November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japan will launch a new round of deep‑sea rare‑earth mud mining tests off Minami‑Tori Shima on February 2, 2027. Shoichi Ishii, the project lead from the Cabinet Office, said on November 20 that the overall test is expected to last 50 days, after which technical feasibility and cost will be evaluated, and results will be compiled by March 2028. The test aims to determine whether, after the rare‑earth mud is brought aboard, it can be consistently mined, transported and refined into usable raw material.

In February this year, the Japan Agency for Marine‑Earth Science and Technology extracted rare‑earth mud from the seabed about 6,000 metres deep off Minami‑Tori Shima, recovering roughly 50 tonnes over three days, not counting the seawater added during operations. Analysis showed that about 54 % of the rare‑earth elements in the sample were mid‑to‑heavy rare earths such as yttrium, gallium and terbium. This figure refers to the composition of the rare‑earth elements, not the overall rare‑earth concentration of the mud batch.

The next round of testing will transport the extracted slurry to Minami‑Tori Shima for dewatering, then ship it to mainland Japan for separation, refining and smelting trials. The previous round mainly verified whether equipment could extract mud at depth; this round will integrate offshore extraction, transport and on‑shore processing to enable cost estimation from mining to finished product.

Japan is pushing this project to diversify its rare‑earth supply and reduce dependence on China. Ishii noted that the effort is still in the research and testing phase. Whether it can become a stable supply source will depend on the ability to scale the entire process and on whether the scaled‑up costs are affordable.

items.title: 銅市／LME銅價跌至3月來低點本週跌9%、恐連六週下跌
items.title_en: Copper Market/LME Copper Prices Fall to March Low, Down 9% This Week, May Extend to Six Consecutive Weeks of Decline
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 倫敦金屬交易所（LME）銅價11月20日回吐前一日漲幅，三個月期銅盤中下跌2.7%至每公噸12,182美元，觸及3月以來最低。本週截至盤中已跌約9%，若跌勢延續，將連續第六週下跌。上海期貨交易所成交最活絡的銅期貨合約下跌3.4%，報每公噸92,400元人民幣，本週跌約12%。
市場擔心AI基礎設施投資的成長步調放慢，重新評估未來資料中心與電網建設的用銅需求。美元接近19個月高點，加上美國升息預期升溫，也對銅價形成壓力。市場對美國加徵銅進口關稅的預期則有所降溫，先前因關稅預期而提前運往美國的部分庫存，已有貿易商改運中國。
全球銅期貨走跌，中國進口現貨溢價卻仍處於歷史高點。兩者並不矛盾：期貨反映市場對未來供需的預期，現貨溢價則反映中國買家為了現在拿到貨，仍願意支付高於基準價的價格。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices on November 20 gave back the previous day's gains, with the three‑month copper contract sliding 2.7% to $12,182 per metric ton, the lowest level since March. The market is down about 9% so far this week, and if the trend continues it will mark a sixth straight week of declines. The most actively traded copper futures contract on the Shanghai Futures Exchange fell 3.4% to 92,400 yuan per ton, down roughly 12% for the week.

The market is worried that the pace of AI‑related infrastructure investment is slowing, prompting a reassessment of copper demand for future data‑center and power‑grid construction. A near 19‑month high for the U.S. dollar, combined with rising expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, is also pressuring copper prices. Expectations of new U.S. copper import tariffs have cooled, and inventories that were previously shipped to the United States in anticipation of tariffs are now being redirected to China by traders.

Global copper futures are falling, yet the spot premium for Chinese imports remains at historically high levels. The two are not contradictory: futures reflect market expectations for future supply and demand, while the spot premium shows that Chinese buyers are still willing to pay above the benchmark price to obtain physical copper now.

items.title: 中國對美氧化釔出口創七個月新高對日出貨仍低、鏑鋱未見出貨
items.title_en: China's Yttrium Oxide Exports to the US Reach Seven-Month High, Shipments to Japan Remain Low, No Dysprosium Shipments Detected
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國10月向美國出口38.5公噸氧化釔，為3月出口60公噸以來最高，超過管制前平均每月約30公噸。不過，同月中國對日本的氧化釔出口僅8公噸，對美、日也都沒有氧化鏑或氧化鋱的出口紀錄。
中國自2025年4月起對包括釔在內的多種稀土產品實施出口管制。此後19個月，中國有9個月未向美國出口氧化釔；10月則是管制後第二個出貨量高於管制前平均的月份。單月出貨回升，還看不出對美供應是否已恢復穩定。
釔的主要用途包括陶瓷和螢光材料，氧化鏑與氧化鋱則可用於製造高性能稀土磁鐵。10月的海關數字顯示，不同品項與目的地的出貨情況並不一致。
※ 本文經「優分析」授權轉載，原文出處:原文連結
※ 免責聲明：文中所提的個股、基金、期貨商品內容僅供參考，並非投資建議，投資人應獨立判斷，審慎評估風險。
paras_en: On November 20, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), China exported 38.5 metric tons of yttrium oxide to the United States in October, the highest level since the 60‑ton export in March and above the pre‑restriction monthly average of about 30 tons. However, in the same month China shipped only 8 tons of yttrium oxide to Japan, and there were no export records of dysprosium oxide or zirconium oxide to either the US or Japan.

China has imposed export controls on a range of rare‑earth products, including yttrium, since April 2025. In the 19 months following the controls, there were nine months with no yttrium oxide shipments to the United States; October marks the second month after the restrictions where the shipment volume exceeded the pre‑restriction average. The rebound in a single month does not yet indicate that supply to the US has stabilized.

Yttrium is primarily used in ceramics and phosphor materials, while dysprosium oxide and zirconium oxide are employed in the production of high‑performance rare‑earth magnets. Customs data for October show that shipment patterns vary across different product categories and destinations.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉半導體股領跌 滬指險守3500點大關 連二日收黑
items.title_en: <China Stock Post‑Market> Semiconductor Stocks Lead Decline, Shanghai Index Hovers Around 3500‑Point Threshold, Two Consecutive Days of Losses
paras: 中國A股三大指數周五(20日)齊步走低，上證指數連續第2個交易日收黑，一度跌深至3500點，因AI新創公司Anthropic上市首日表現未能帶領全球科技股止跌。
盤面上，半導體股全日表現低迷，通富微電、金海通盤觸及跌停，阿石創、芯導科技、賽微電子、沫曦股份、盛科通訊跌幅居前；光刻機族群持續下挫，聯合化學、張江高科跌停，久日新材、波長光電、賽微電子跌幅居前；小家電族群重挫，彩虹集團、小熊電器、愛仕達、比依股份觸及跌停，鴻智科技、北鼎股份、利仁科技跌幅居前。
上漲族群方面，電子零件類股​​衝高回落，滿坤科技、駿亞科技、中京電子、東晶電子、澳弘電子、超音波電子觸及漲停，金祿電子、四會富仕、科翔股份漲幅居前；豬肉股表現活躍，金新農漲停，東瑞股份、唐人神、華統股份漲幅居前；銀行股尾盤快速拉升，工商銀行、建設銀行、中信銀行等創新高，平安銀行、交通銀行、農業銀行等逆勢上漲超1%。
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共313檔股票上漲，5234檔下跌，平盤31檔。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共35檔股票漲幅在9%以上，302檔股票跌幅在9%以上。

財信證券表示，市場仍在縮量築底框架內運行，滬指在3550點支撐附近雖有反覆，但未有效失守，但題材波動大、賺錢效應偏弱、情緒低迷。縮量既可為築底，亦可為下跌中繼：若有效跌破3550點且跌停家數繼續放大，則築底框架失效，需防進一步下探;。若放量收復3600點、同時市場賺錢效應有所回暖，可視為情緒修復的初步確認。反攻信號未出現前，維持觀察。方向上，一是半導體製造與材料；二是紅利與消費；三是國產算力鏈。中期來看，海外AI產業鏈不確定性、海外流動性偏緊、硬科技籌碼結構不佳、風險偏好回升仍需時間，增量政策集中出台或外圍風險實質改善將是市場走出調整的關鍵觸發，重點觀察年底中央經濟工作會議前後的市場表現。
萬家基金認為，A股在經歷大幅調整後，後續總體將呈現「寬幅震盪、底部中樞溫和抬升」的格局。 當前市場正處於政策底向基本面底過渡的階段。A股估值已處於歷史偏低分位點，後續搭配穩增長政策托底，具備較厚的安全邊際。後市來看，受制於有效需求修復的斜率及增量資金的觀望情緒，指數向上突破仍需更多宏觀數據的驗證。
國泰基金建議，當前市場仍處於震盪整理階段，成交量持續收縮，反映資金風險偏好尚未全面恢復。考慮到海外政策、AI資本開支回報及市場流動性等不確定性仍在，短期或應以防範波動風險為主，兼顧穩健配置與超跌方向的潛在修復機會，密切關注市場成交及右側企穩信號，避免過度追高。
中原證券認為，當前滬指與創業板指的平均本益比分別為15.77倍、33.52倍，處於近三年中位數平均水平上方，預計滬指繼續震盪整理的可能性較大，結構再平衡為核心特徵，短線建議關注半導體、稀土、電子化學品及航空機場等行業的投資機會。
中信建投證券首席經濟學家黃文濤團隊近日在2027年投資策略報告中提出，「中國向強、經濟向新、市場向上」的核心判斷。在此背景下，A股定價邏輯與流動性結構正被重塑，中國明年股、債、匯均有望走強。配置層面，該團隊建議明年投資者重點增配「人民幣貨幣錨資產」，穩健配置「人民幣流動性資產。
paras_en: China A‑share’s three major indices all fell on Friday (the 20th), with the Shanghai Composite closing in the red for the second consecutive trading day and briefly slipping to the 3,500‑point level, as AI start‑up Anthropic’s debut failed to lift global tech stocks.

The Shanghai Composite fell 1.22% to 3,533.79 points on Friday and is down 2.77% for the week; the Shenzhen Component dropped 3.09% to 10,256.39 points, a cumulative weekly loss of 6.49%; the ChiNext index fell 3.54% to 2,212.13 points, down 8.82% for the week.

On the market, semiconductor stocks were weak all day, with Tongfu Microelectronics and Jinhaitong hitting their daily limits down, while A‑Stone Creation, XinTech, Saimei Electronics, MoXi Co., and Shengke Communications posted the biggest declines; lithography‑machine stocks kept sliding, with United Chemicals and Zhangjiang Hi‑Tech hitting limit‑down, and Jiuri New Materials, Wavelength Optoelectronics and Saimei Electronics among the top losers; small‑appliance stocks crashed, with Rainbow Group, Little Bear Appliances, Aishida and Biyi Co. hitting limit‑down, while Hongzhi Technology, Beiding Co. and Liren Technology fell sharply.

Among the gainers, electronic component stocks surged then retreated, with ManKun Technology, Junya Technology, Zhongjing Electronics, Dongjing Electronics, Ao Hong Electronics and Ultrasonic Electronics hitting limit‑up, while Jinlu Electronics, Si Hui Fu Shi and Kexiang Co. led the rise; pork‑related stocks were active, with Jin Xin Nong hitting limit‑up and Dongrui, Tangrenshen and Huatong posting notable gains; bank stocks rallied sharply in the closing minutes, with ICBC, China Construction Bank and CITIC Bank reaching fresh highs, while Ping An Bank, Bank of Communications and Agricultural Bank rose more than 1% against the trend.

According to Wind data, a total of 313 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges, 5,234 fell and 31 were unchanged. Dazhihui VIP data shows that 35 stocks across the three markets gained more than 9%, while 302 stocks fell more than 9%.

CaiXin Securities said the market is still operating within a low‑volume bottom‑building framework; the Shanghai index has bounced around the 3,550‑point support but has not convincingly broken it, with large thematic swings, weak profit‑making effect and low sentiment. Low volume can signal either bottom‑building or a down‑trend continuation: a decisive break below 3,550 with more limit‑down stocks would invalidate the bottom framework and call for protection against further declines; conversely, a volume‑driven recovery above 3,600 with improving profit‑making sentiment would mark the first sign of emotional repair. Until a clear counter‑attack signal appears, they remain observational. The focus areas are: 1) semiconductor manufacturing and materials; 2) dividends and consumption; 3) domestic computing‑power chain. In the medium term, uncertainties in overseas AI supply chains, tight overseas liquidity, weak hard‑tech capital structures and a slow rebound in risk appetite mean that policy stimulus and tangible improvements in external risks will be key triggers for the market to exit correction, especially around the central economic work conference at year‑end.

WanJia Fund believes that after a sharp correction, A‑shares will likely enter a pattern of “wide‑range oscillation with a gently rising central bottom.” The market is currently transitioning from a policy‑driven bottom to a fundamentals‑driven bottom. A‑share valuations are at historically low levels, and with steady‑growth policies providing support, there is a substantial safety margin. Looking ahead, the pace of effective demand recovery and cautious sentiment among incremental capital will require further macro data to confirm any upward breakout.

Guotai Fund advises that the market remains in a consolidation phase with shrinking trading volume, indicating that risk appetite has not fully recovered. Given ongoing uncertainties around overseas policies, AI capital‑expenditure returns and market liquidity, short‑term focus should be on mitigating volatility risk while balancing stable allocations with potential rebounds in oversold segments, closely monitoring market turnover and right‑side stabilization signals to avoid over‑buying.

Zhongyuan Securities notes that the Shanghai Composite and ChiNext average price‑to‑earnings ratios are currently 15.77 × and 33.52 × respectively, above the three‑year median averages. They expect the Shanghai index to continue oscillating within a consolidation range, with structural rebalancing as the core feature, and suggest short‑term attention to investment opportunities in semiconductors, rare‑earths, electronic chemicals and airport‑related sectors.

CITIC Securities chief economist Huang Wentao’s team, in its 2027 investment strategy report, put forward the core view that “China will be strong, the economy will be new, and the market will rise.” In this context, A‑share pricing logic and liquidity structure are being reshaped, and China’s equities, bonds and currency are all expected to strengthen next year. For allocation, the team recommends increasing exposure to “RMB‑denominated monetary‑anchor assets” and maintaining a stable position in “RMB liquidity assets.”

items.title: 方舟「木頭姐」砸9000萬美元搶進Anthropic 減持輝達因應監管風暴
items.title_en: Ark’s “Wood” Dumps $90 Million to Rush Into Anthropic, Cuts Nvidia Amid Regulatory Storm
paras: 知名投資人「木頭姐」伍德(Cathie Wood)旗下的方舟投資(ARK Invest)，在Anthropic (ANT-US)上市首日，就毫不客氣利用旗下六檔基金，買入了約 93.5 萬股 Anthropic 股票。此外，由於晶片大廠輝達(NVDA-US)在中國市場的曝險部位引發日益嚴格的監管審視，伍德選擇減持輝達股票。
根據最新申報交易記錄，ARK 於 AI 模型開發商 Anthropic 上市首日，透過旗下 6 檔交易所交易基金(ETF)大手筆買入約 93.5 萬股，總投資金額約 7,760 萬至 9,000 萬美元。其中，旗艦基金 ARKK 買入 55.6 萬股為最大大宗。
與此同時，ARK 減持輝達，經由 ARKQ 基金賣出 33,430 股，套現約 500 萬美元。
Anthropic 此次那斯達克IPO發行價為每股 83 美元，成功籌集 813 億美元，打破全球歷史最大 IPO 紀錄。掛牌首日開盤價達 111.50 美元，終場收在 97.17 美元，較發行價上漲約 17%，完全稀釋後的市值高達近 1.8 兆美元。財報顯示，公司截至 9 月底的前九個月營收達 332.4 億美元，較去年同期狂增 1,200%。
相對地，輝達近期面臨嚴峻的監管調查與高層震盪。加州檢察總長邦塔(Rob Bonta)發出調查傳票，對其先進晶片是否違反美國出口限制違法流入中國市場展開調查。此外，前執行長黃仁勳因坦承婚外情而請辭，目前由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)暫代職務。利空籠罩下，輝達股價連續下挫，自 10 月高點回檔約 38%。
市場法人指出，方舟投資本次「買進 Anthropic、削減輝達」的組合操作，反映出在輝達面臨監管陰影與管理過渡期之際，機構資金正加速轉向剛上市且高速成長的 AI 模型領導業者。
paras_en: Renowned investor “Wood” (Cathie Wood) and her firm ARK Invest used six of its funds to buy roughly 935,000 shares of Anthropic (ANT‑US) on the stock’s first trading day, spending about $90 million. At the same time, because chip giant Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is facing tighter regulatory scrutiny over its exposure in China, Wood chose to reduce her Nvidia holdings.

According to the latest filing, ARK on Anthropic’s debut day bought about 935,000 shares through six exchange‑traded funds, investing roughly $77.6 million to $90 million. The flagship ARKK fund made the biggest purchase, acquiring 556,000 shares.
Meanwhile, ARK trimmed its Nvidia position, with the ARKQ fund selling 33,430 shares for roughly $5 million in cash.

Anthropic’s Nasdaq IPO was priced at $83 per share, raising $8.13 billion and setting a record as the largest IPO in history. The stock opened at $111.50 on day one and closed at $97.17, about 17% above the offering price, giving a fully diluted market cap of nearly $1.8 trillion. The company reported revenue of $33.24 billion for the nine months ended September, a staggering 1,200% increase year‑over‑year.

Conversely, Nvidia has been hit by a harsh regulatory probe and executive turmoil. California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued a subpoena investigating whether Nvidia’s advanced chips illegally flowed to China in violation of U.S. export rules. Former CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting an extramarital affair, with CFO Colette Kress temporarily assuming the role. Under the cloud of these setbacks, Nvidia’s share price has fallen about 38% from its October peak.

Market analysts note that ARK’s “buy Anthropic, cut Nvidia” strategy reflects a shift of institutional capital toward newly listed, fast‑growing AI model leaders as Nvidia grapters with regulatory shadows and a management transition.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行強力穩盤 收32.936元升值0.6分
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Strongly Stabilizes, Closes at 32.936, Up 0.6 Points
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日再度破底，市場出現強烈的去槓桿壓力，單日跌點達2393點，創史上第三大跌點，一周來已跌掉7641點，周跌幅17.5%，台北匯市見到中央銀行全力穩盤調節，新台幣終場收在32.936元，升值0.6分，與股市脫鉤，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至21.02億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.8分開出後，盤中一度轉升值，午盤過後又見貶值壓力湧出，收盤半小時又轉升，顯示來回拋補的拉鋸力道激烈，但成交量萎縮，全日高低價差1.2角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元強彈超過0.4%，人民幣升0.3%，星元升0.15%上下，泰銖升約0.1%，新台幣收升0.02%，而韓元貶值約0.1%。
法人分析，聯準會官員有提到AI的蓬勃發展正在加劇經濟過熱風險，企業投資達到空前規模但經濟產能未必承受得住，使聯準會將不得不應對短期影響，而這些影響目前看來是推升通膨，在此鷹派聲浪下，暫難見到帶動外資回頭的訊號，使匯市偏弱整理。
paras_en: The Taiwan weighted index broke its low again today (20th), with the market under strong deleveraging pressure. It fell 2,393 points in a single day, the third‑largest point drop in history, and has lost 7,641 points over the past week, a weekly decline of 17.5%. In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the central bank stepped in forcefully to stabilize the currency; the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.936, appreciating 0.6 points and decoupling from the equity market. Turnover at Taipei FX brokers shrank to US$2.102 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.96, down 1.8 points, then rose briefly during the session. After the midday break, depreciation pressure resurfaced, but in the half‑hour before close it turned upward again, showing a fierce tug‑of‑war between buying and selling. However, trading volume contracted and the daily high‑low range was only 0.12 yuan.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen surged more than 0.4%, the Chinese renminbi rose 0.3%, the Singapore dollar gained about 0.15%, the Thai baht edged up roughly 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar finished up 0.02%, while the South Korean won depreciated about 0.1%.

Analysts note that Federal Reserve officials have warned that the rapid growth of AI is heightening the risk of an overheated economy. Corporate investment is reaching unprecedented levels, but productive capacity may not keep pace, forcing the Fed to address short‑term impacts that currently appear to be feeding inflation. Amid this hawkish sentiment, there is little sign of foreign capital returning, leaving the FX market in a weak, consolidating stance.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: USD Near ¥160, Market Moves Cautiously
paras: ◆USD/JPY

據10月美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)會議紀錄顯示，決策者一致同意暫時維持率不變，但認為或許需要加大力度控制通貨膨脹的風險上升，並據FED理事沃勒和巴爾發表鷹派言論，而且國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)總裁格奧爾基耶娃週四稱，能源供應衝擊和人工智能(AI)需求推動全球通貨膨脹率加速升至4.7%，許多經濟體將收緊貨幣政策，強化FED再加息的基調，推動美元升至十九個月高點；此外，日本9月核心機械訂單較上年同期增13.4%不及預期，但較前月減少0.3%優於預估值，並據路透調查，多數經濟學家預估日本央行(BOJ)在12月會議宣布今年第三次升息及明年3月底前再加息一次，而且BOJ總裁植田和男向國會表示，通貨膨脹增速可能漸放緩，但名義工資穩步上漲及家庭收入增加支撐消費，並預計消費恢復溫和上升趨勢，暗示近期再升息，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓盤整於159.26低點。
隨後美國數據顯示上周初請失業金人數微升至20.3萬人及費城聯邦儲備銀行11月製造業指數降至正6.3，而且世界大型企業研究會公布美國10月領先指標跌0.3%遜於預期，但市場持續對FED進一步加息的押注，而且避險資金回流減弱，推升美元兌日圓至159.96高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.60-80，支撐於158.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)布雷曼稱，通貨膨脹仍高於目標重點，經濟復甦進程不均衡，並據澳洲統計局公布10月就業人口減少4.35萬，為連續第二個月下降，失業率則攀升至五年新高4.9%，數據意外疲軟進一步強化澳洲央行(RBA)利率可能已見頂及下一步將降息的觀點，而且利率掉期市場目前已不再計入RBA再升息的可能性及預計明年下半年將啟動降息，衝擊澳幣及紐元走低，拖累歐元兌美元盤整於1.0954低點。

隨著法國央行(BOF)總裁穆蘭表示，油價上漲仍在推高物價壓力，歐洲央行(ECB)必須保持警惕，並據ECB數據顯示，歐元區9月經常帳盈餘小幅擴大至125億歐元，而且德國央行(Bundesbank)於月度經濟報告中指出，得益於穩健出口需求及財政刺激措施，德國今年經濟增長意外強勁，增速可能在今年第四季度回升及通貨膨脹可能加速，提振歐元兌美元至1.1010高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.0975-95，支撐於1.0890-1.0910。
◆GBP/USD

據英國央行(BOE)預測顯示，英國通貨膨脹將創上世紀九十年代初以來最長時間未降至2%以下紀錄，恐削弱公眾對BOE能否將物價漲幅拉回目標及長期維持該水平附近的信心，而且伊朗戰爭影響能源價格飆升，料使英國通貨膨脹率明年年中升至近5%，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3174高點下滑。隨後英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布11月工業趨勢訂單差值升至負12，但市場關注週五英國首相伯納姆與歐盟高峰會如何扭轉脫離歐盟局面，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3091低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3090-1.3110，支撐於1.3000-20。

paras_en: USD/JPY

According to the October Federal Reserve (FED) meeting minutes, policymakers unanimously agreed to keep rates unchanged for now, but said inflation risks may require stronger action. Fed governors Waller and Bahl made hawkish remarks, and IMF chief Georgieva said on Thursday that energy supply shocks and AI demand are pushing global inflation up to 4.7%, prompting many economies to tighten policy and reinforcing the Fed’s rate‑hike bias, which has lifted the dollar to a 19‑month high. In Japan, September core machinery orders rose 13.4% year‑on‑year, missing expectations but falling 0.3% month‑on‑month, better than forecast. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to announce its third rate hike of the year in December and another hike before the end of March 2025. BOJ Governor Ueda told parliament that inflation may be easing gradually, but steady nominal wage growth and higher household income support consumption, which is expected to resume a modest upward trend, hinting at a near‑term hike that could support the yen, keeping USD/JPY around the low of 159.26.

Subsequent US data showed initial jobless claims ticked up to 203,000 and the Philadelphia Fed’s November manufacturing index fell to +6.3. The ISM leading‑index for October slipped 0.3% versus expectations. Markets continue betting on further Fed hikes while safe‑haven flows receded, pushing USD/JPY to a high of 159.96. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance at 159.60‑80 and support at 158.70‑90 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) governor, Brett, said inflation remains above target and the economic recovery is uneven. Australia’s Bureau of Statistics reported that October employment fell by 43,500 for the second consecutive month and the unemployment rate rose to a five‑year high of 4.9%. The weak data bolsters the view that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may have peaked on rates and could cut later, with the rate‑swap market now pricing out any further RBA hikes and expecting cuts in the second half of next year. This pressure drags the Australian and New Zealand dollars lower and keeps EUR/USD flat around the low of 1.0954.

With French central bank (Banque de France) governor Villeroy noting that rising oil prices continue to fuel price pressures, the European Central Bank must stay vigilant. ECB data show the euro‑area’s September current‑account surplus modestly widened to €12.5 billion, and the Bundesbank’s monthly report highlighted that strong export demand and fiscal stimulus have led to unexpectedly robust German growth, which could pick up again in Q4 and push inflation higher, lifting EUR/USD to a high of 1.1010. Resistance today is seen at 1.0975‑95 with support at 1.0890‑1.0910.
GBP/USD

Bank of England forecasts indicate that UK inflation may stay above 2% for the longest stretch since the early 1990s, eroding confidence that the BOE can bring price gains back to target and keep them near that level. The Iran‑related war has driven energy prices up, likely pushing UK inflation to near 5% by mid‑next year and dragging the pound from its recent high of 1.3174 against the dollar. Later, the CBI reported that November industrial order balance fell to –12, and markets are watching how Prime Minister Sunak’s summit with the EU on Friday might affect the post‑Brexit situation, pressuring the pound down to a low of 1.3091. Today’s pound‑dollar resistance is 1.3090‑1.3110 with support at 1.3000‑1.3020.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元漲勢暫歇 Anthropic上市提振風險偏好 日元走貶
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。
瑞銀考量澳洲通膨仍高，以及勞動與房市情況惡化，將澳洲央行首次降息時間預測，由明年11月提前至8月，並將預估降息次數由兩次增加至三次。
英鎊兌美元升值0.1%，報1英鎊兌1.3162美元，但英鎊兌歐元則從20個月高點回落。投資人仍看好英國利率前景，同時對歐洲2027年多場重要選舉可能為歐元帶來的阻力保持警戒。
加密貨幣方面，受風險偏好改善帶動，比特幣上漲2.5%，報63,870美元，脫離上週日觸及的四個月低點62,026美元。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

paras: 台北股匯市遭逢雙殺壓力，除了金管會自明(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，中央銀行也積極調節匯市波動，終場收在32.942元，升值0.5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值則縮至22.63億美元。
新台幣今日以32.96元、貶值1.3分開出後，最低一度貶至33.04元，但觸及33元心理大關後貶勢並未擴大，收盤前15分鐘更轉升，收在32.942元，高低價差1.2角。
由於成交值較昨日見收斂，法人解讀資金拋補大鬥法已稍微緩解，不過，尚未見到台股的止跌訊號，匯市能否就此守住無形的33元防線，仍受到市場密切關注。
觀察主要亞幣，日元貶值約0.3%，新台幣收升0.02%，星元和人民幣微幅波動不到0.05%，韓元升0.1%左右，泰銖升0.2%，而美元指數小跌近0.1%。
法人指出，聯準會內部鷹派釋出12月應考慮升息2碼的訊息，令市場風險意識持續提高，同時，後黃仁勳時代的AI投資焦慮高漲，AI估值調整壓力持續消化中。
值得留意的是，獨立新創AI Anthropic將在台灣時間今日晚上掛牌，掛牌行情成另一個左右市場信心的重要焦點。
paras_en: Taipei stock and forex markets faced double‑kill pressure. Starting today (20th), the Financial Supervisory Commission rolled out five major measures to stabilise the stock market, including re‑instating the "conditional short‑selling ban". The central bank also actively adjusted FX market volatility, ending the session at 32.942, up 0.5 points, while the turnover of Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms shrank to $2.263 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 32.96, down 1.3 points, fell to a low of 33.04, but after hitting the psychological 33‑level the decline did not deepen. In the last 15 minutes before close it turned higher, finishing at 32.942, with a daily range of 1.2 jiao.

Because turnover narrowed compared with yesterday, institutional investors interpret that the large‑scale fund‑outflow battle has eased somewhat, yet no clear bottoming signal has appeared for the Taiwan stock market. Whether the FX market can now hold the intangible 33‑level barrier remains under close market scrutiny.

Looking at major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen weakened about 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.02%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan fluctuated less than 0.05%, the Korean won rose roughly 0.1%, the Thai baht rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index slipped nearly 0.1%.

Institutions note that hawkish voices inside the Fed have signalled that a 20‑basis‑point rate hike should be considered in December, raising market risk awareness. At the same time, AI‑investment anxiety is soaring in the post‑Jensen Huang era, and pressure from AI valuation adjustments continues to be digested.
Worth noting is that the independent AI startup Anthropic will list tonight Taiwan time, and its debut price will become another key focus influencing market confidence.

The NAHB survey reported the October existing‑home‑sales‑to‑inventory index slipped 4.7% to 63, the lowest since the series began in 2001. EUR/USD

The ECB’s financial‑stability report noted that market pressure should prompt France to take self‑disciplinary measures on its high‑debt issue, signalling no rush to intervene in member‑state debt problems, which has pushed EUR/USD down to a low of 1.0952. Perez指出，「這正是目前支撐美元走強的市場信念。」

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 18th), reaching a 19‑month high, boosted by hawkish comments from Fed official Christopher Waller and recent economic data, solidifying market expectations of a rate hike next month.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.78, the highest since April 2025.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refused to provide forward guidance, causing investors to rely more on economic data and remarks from other policymakers to gauge the Fed’s next move.

In a CNBC interview, Waller said that if the central bank wants to bring inflation down, it must take more “aggressive action,” including a 0.5‑percentage‑point rate hike at the December meeting or guiding market expectations in the post‑meeting statement to prepare for further hikes.

Last week’s inflation data came in hotter than expected, leading the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December while still seeing a small chance of a 50‑basis‑point increase. CME Group’s FedWatch tool showed that Tuesday’s data, which reported modest growth in U.S. retail sales for October, further reinforced expectations of a rate hike next month.
Juan Perez, senior director of Monex USA’s Washington trading desk, said, “The Fed now appears very resolute in preparing to raise rates, and may even adopt a more aggressive tightening path.”
Perez added, “That is the market belief currently underpinning the dollar’s strength.”
However, strategists warned that for the dollar to keep climbing, a new bullish catalyst may be needed.

Dilin Wu, a strategist at Pepperstone, said, “To push the dollar significantly higher from current levels, the market may need to start pricing in a more aggressive rate‑hike trajectory through 2027.”

CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect the Fed’s benchmark rate to be about 75 basis points higher in 12 months, landing in the 4.50%‑4.75% range. Investors will also watch later remarks from New York Fed President John Williams, Fed Governor Michael Barr, and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari to gauge the central bank’s next policy step.
The dollar’s rally has pushed other major currencies toward multi‑month lows.
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.09735, briefly touching its lowest level since April 2025.
The pound slipped 0.3% to $1.3165, a one‑month low. Data showed Britain’s core inflation for October held steady month‑over‑month, easing market expectations of an imminent BoE rate hike.

The yen was roughly flat at ¥159.29 per dollar. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated that monetary policy still needs further tightening. The yen remains near the level the Japanese government intervened at in July this year to support the weak currency.

Markets also focused on the three‑way summit scheduled for Thursday in Shenzhen, attended by U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The talks could cover Russia’s war in Ukraine, the Iran conflict, as well as trade, AI and nuclear issues.

paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar today (18th) under continued pressure from foreign investors selling stocks and repatriating funds once again fell below the 33 NTD whole‑number mark; in the half hour before market close the depreciation eased, ending at 32.947 NTD, down 9.7 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume remained at a historically high relative level, at US$2.731 billion.
Institutional interpretation: the NT$ closing within the 33‑NTD threshold is a strong signal from the central bank.
The NT$ opened today at 32.83 NTD, up 2 cents, then kept falling, reaching a low of 33.023 NTD, with a high‑low spread of 0.193 NTD.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won rebounded more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated nearly 0.1%, the Chinese yuan hovered flat with narrow fluctuations, the Singapore dollar slipped about 0.1%, and the NT$ fell 0.3%; the US dollar index rose over 0.2%.
